subject: They get richer; we get sicker

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39479%2E3422442%2EW6zCEV)
Dear Derek,
It’s been two months since the new Congress was sworn in, and Washington Republicans have wasted no time showing their true colors.
Their priority: giveaways for billionaires. On the chopping block: our health care.
House Republicans’ recently passed budget calls for billions of dollars in cuts to Medicare and Medicaid—while their rich friends get billions in tax breaks.
Here are the stakes for patients. Americans will have to pay more each month for their premiums. Families will get kicked off their health insurance, threatening financial disaster if they get sick. People will forgo care they need because they can’t afford it, and they will get sicker—or even lose their lives—as a result.
**This is an emergency, and we need to make our voices heard.** We stopped Congressional Republicans in 2017 when they tried to repeal the Affordable Care Act, and we protected our health care in 2018 by retaking the House. We can do it again.
With your help, we were able to win in critical swing seats across the country last year, restricting Republicans to a 2-seat majority in the House. Next year, we need to double down on these efforts to flip Congress and elect even more health care champions to put our interests ahead of wealthy donors. **[If you’re in, can you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to send a clear message to Washington Republicans: when they come for our health care, we’re going to be right there holding them accountable?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20250303?refcode=em20250303-39479&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39479_3422442_W6zCEV&akid=39479%2E3422442%2EW6zCEV)**
Thanks for considering,
Team TTP

Former U.S. Congresswoman Katie Porter founded Truth to Power to support the campaigns of her fellow Democrats. Truth to Power supports candidates who will stand up to Donald Trump, fight to lower costs, and protect the environment. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20250303-39479&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39479_3422442_W6zCEV&akid=39479%2E3422442%2EW6zCEV)**

subject: This is why we don’t give up.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
In a time when it feels like everything is crumbling, we want to show you the victories that prove otherwise.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103176536/531404821/1328794144?refcode=ea.dc2dfab9-8ef8-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&ms=ea.dc2dfab9-8ef8-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRjMmRmYWI5LThlZjgtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNiNSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BvdMrTPLHHKMuJWNedImLP_pTtWNO-MrHrkuGAgmUMI=&emci=dcfccfef-6ff8-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&emdi=dc2dfab9-8ef8-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&ceid=4823105)
---
Take a deep breath. Yes, things are chaotic. Yes, it seems like Trump is trying to bulldoze everything in his path. But if you only take one thing away from this email, let it be this: **Even in the darkest moments, grassroots power is making a difference.** Before we break it all down, **[can we count on you to chip in a few dollars to help elect climate champions and defend our progress?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103176537/531404822/2105508926?refcode=ea.dc2dfab9-8ef8-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&ms=ea.dc2dfab9-8ef8-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRjMmRmYWI5LThlZjgtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNiNSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BvdMrTPLHHKMuJWNedImLP_pTtWNO-MrHrkuGAgmUMI=)** **FIRST:** **Grassroots supporters like you helped us elect nearly 100 climate champions in high-stakes races across the country in 2024.** Some by just a handful of votes. And now, those leaders are holding the line in state legislatures, city councils, and county commissions. They’re stopping Trump’s extremist allies from tearing apart our communities. **THEN:** We proved our power in the first big test of Trump’s presidency. **Two consequential special elections** — one in Minnesota, one in Virginia — sent a clear message: We’re not backing down. ✅ **Kannan Srinivasan’s victory** kept the Virginia Senate in pro-climate hands and slammed the door shut on Trump-backed Republicans who wanted to gut clean energy progress. ✅ And **Doron Clark’s win** in Minnesota restored the DFL’s narrow majority in the State Senate — paving the way for continued progress toward the state’s ambitious climate goals. **AND NOW:** Our endorsed leaders are showing up where it matters most.
* **In Virginia,** Democrats wasted no time using their majority to push constitutional amendments protecting voting rights, marriage equality, and abortion access — exactly the kind of policies Republicans wanted to destroy.

* **In Congress, Rep. Greg Casar** fought back against the GOP’s efforts to undermine essential social services, right in the middle of their own hearing. While Republicans used the DOGE Subcommittee to attack Social Security and working families, Casar flipped the script and exposed the real issue: Elon Musk’s companies quietly receiving billions in taxpayer money while the GOP scrutinizes meager payments to people who depend on government support.

* And last month, our endorsed leaders took to the streets. **Reps. Maxwell Frost, Jasmine Crockett, and Sydney Kamlager-Dove** joined hundreds of protesters outside the Treasury Department to demand answers after Trump handed Musk and his unelected team of inexperienced youths access to government financial systems. While Republicans — and even some Democrats — stayed silent, they stepped up.

The Latino Vote Podcast Season 2025 Episode 6

## **DOGE TEXAS: Removing Incentives for Illegal Immigration**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-skhjlhk-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, March 3, 2025 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation releases our latest solutions paper from our DOGE Texas Project, [_Texas First: _Removing Incentives for Illegal Immigration](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-skhjlhk-yuddtktydi-j/).Illegal immigration costs Texans over $13 billion annually. President Donald Trump has stepped up and is doing exactly what Texas should and could have done years ago.In support of President Trump's decisive action to secure the border, Texas must aggressively do whatever possible to eliminate policies that encourage illegal immigration. This report outlines key policy solutions, including:
* Enforce E-Verify for All Texas Businesses
* End In-State Tuition for Illegal Immigrant
* Require Proof of Citizenship for Government School Enrollment
* Ban Remittances to Mexico and Other Foreign Nations by Illegal Aliens
* Stop Medicaid Coverage for Non-Citizens Giving Birth
* Invoke State Powers to Expel Illegal Immigrants
* Prohibit Illegal Aliens from Buying or Leasing Property in Texas

By removing these incentives, Texas can better support President Trump's mission to secure America's borders, increase self-deportations, and DOGE government waste.[_Click here to read HLF's latest solutions paper._](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-skhjlhk-yuddtktydi-t/) [Read / Share Solutions Paper](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-skhjlhk-yuddtktydi-i/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-partisan research institute. ➜ Mass firings in the civil service. Elon Musk's DOGE team started with a buyout scheme for federal employees and is now threatening layoffs. Project 2025 calls for replacing them with MAGA henchmen.
➜ Military immigration enforcement. They've promised to deploy U.S. troops on our domestic borders.
➜ Persecuting transgender Americans. The Trump administration has attacked gender identity across the board.
➜ Environmental rollbacks. From pulling out of the Paris Climate Accords (again) to opening Alaska's land to drilling to valuing fossil fuels over all other forms of energy production, they're dismantling environmental regulation piece by piece.

| | | Dear friend,

My friend Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren is an unsung hero for defending our democracy and our Constitution.

I had not known Zoe well before our work together on the House Select Committee to Investigate the January 6th attack on the United States Capitol, but I was aware of her reputation as one of the most effective and respected Members of the House of Representatives. She is a thoughtful and serious member, and she operates with zero ego — a rarity in Congress.

Zoe has been a source of wisdom and good judgment for me and many Members in Congress. Although we don’t share many views on politics or public policy, I can assure you that we need Zoe in Congress and on the frontlines as we continue to protect and secure the future of our democracy.

We all must look beyond party and support people like Zoe who will defend the Constitution, someone we know will do the right thing. _We need good, smart, honest and honorable people in elected office._

# [#]
I don’t think I’ll ever get tired of saying it: Thank you!

Just this week, our campaign faced our February fundraising goal — one of the toughest goals to hit because it’s a short month.

But I’m proud to share that we hit (and exceeded) our fundraising goal! Thank you for your continued support in our mission to keep California’s 25th blue, and defend the progress we’ve made in Congress.

Your support is what carried us past our goal this week — and it’s exactly what’s going to power my fight against MAGA extremism in Congress over the next two years. This isn’t a fight for one, or even two — defending the rights we hold dear will take all of us.

And together, we’ll do just that. If you didn’t get a chance to chip in before the deadline, don’t worry: you can still do so and make just as big of an impact by clicking here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruiz-em-fr-mar25?amount=10]

Raul

In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. With each investment for college, he made a promise to come back home and serve his community as a physician. In 2012, he decided to take his service to the community to the next level by running for Congress. Dr. Ruiz needs our help to continue fighting for us in Congress.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: Are Americans Stuck?
body:
The answer is almost certainly ‘Yes,’ if not in the way that you think. | |
---
| | |
---

| The answer is almost certainly ‘Yes,’ if not in the way that you think. Back in 2020 I had a policy called ‘Get Americans Moving Again.’ It was meant to address the fact that Americans were relocating for new opportunities less frequently than in times past. Yoni Appelbaum, the author of ‘Stuck: How the Privileged and the Propertied Broke the Engine of American Opportunity,’ believes this is one of the biggest things holding back American prosperity. “For 200 years, Americans moved to the places with faster growing economies, and they weren’t always the same places. Moving to Flint, Michigan in the 1920s was a terrific bet. In the 2020s it is not a terrific bet . . . for 200 years, the gap between the richest places and the poorest places was narrowing because people would move from poor places to rich places.” I interview Yoni about his book on the podcast this week. The statistics are startling: In the 1800s, Americans were so mobile that one out of 3 moved every year. In the 1960s, about one out of every five Americans moved in any given year, a rate of 20%. In 2023, that was down to one in 13, or about 7.7%. Why do we move less? Yoni pegs the culprit as zoning laws. Housing became much more expensive in high-growth markets like New York or Boston or San Francisco because of restrictions on building in various areas. “America is often described as suffering from a housing crisis, but that’s not quite right. In many parts of the country, housing is cheap and abundant, but good jobs and good schools are scarce. Other areas are rich in opportunities but short on affordable homes.” He’s right; I spent months traveling to the Midwest and there are very reasonably priced homes anywhere you look. The jobs and growth opportunities might be hundreds of miles away. In high-growth cities and affluent suburbs, however, it’s extraordinarily difficult to build housing for the average family. In Manhattan, 27 percent of all lots are now in historic districts or are otherwise landmarked. By one estimate, the decline in mobility is costing America $2 trillion each year in lost productivity. The toll is more personal too. “People who have recently changed residences report experiencing more supportive relationships and feeling more optimism, greater sense of purpose, and increased self-respect. Those who want to move and cannot, by contrast, become more cynical and less satisfied with their lives.” More and more, people want to move but never actually do. So what can be done? I’m an advisor to [PadSplit](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=0aa7d4f64e&e=0f227c2ae3), a company that makes it easier for people to rent a spare bedroom. Yoni makes a couple of recommendations. First, let people build near you and join your neighborhood. Stop stopping new developments. Let people build. Rules should apply uniformly across different neighborhoods and communities. Second, be more tolerant of what growth and change could look like, even if the new buildings don’t look good to you. Third, have an approach of abundance. We need a lot of new supply in attractive regions. Many of these changes will be engendered locally. Yoni has taken a fascinating lens to an underrated problem in American life – we don’t move enough. If we change that, it would improve our culture and economy immeasurably. Call it Doing the Unstuck. For my interview of Yoni, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=c40a6566fb&e=0f227c2ae3). For his book, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=cbb3c32999&e=0f227c2ae3). To see what Forward is doing in your community to help improve local policy, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9e6622b6b9&e=0f227c2ae3).

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Extreme fire danger, 50 mph gusts aim for South Texas Tuesday** ," San Antonio Express-News'**Anthony Franze** -- "A strong low pressure system is moving over the Desert Southwest Monday, heading east toward the Lone Star State. This weather system will provide the energy necessary to [initiate strong thunderstorms](https://substack.com/redirect/266b574a-b546-49ed-9c86-0e44417c7e86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in parts of North and East Texas, as well as create extreme fire danger across much of South-Central and West Texas.

The weather system will [send a strong Pacific cold front through the region early Tuesday morning.](https://substack.com/redirect/e176c8fd-570f-45a3-90e8-3451769c55bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) This front will not affect temperatures in a major way, but it will bring very strong wind speeds, along with exceptionally dry air into San Antonio on Tuesday. Together, that's a recipe for extreme fire danger.

This is not to be taken lightly. The National Weather Service said in [their area forecast discussion on Monday afternoon](https://substack.com/redirect/2734852e-e6a7-40ce-8168-39ff833d31df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "Tuesday will feature the most extreme fire danger experienced across South Central Texas in years."

A broken line of showers and storms may occur near the San Antonio area during the predawn hours Tuesday, mainly between 4 and 8 a.m. Overall rain chances are only 20%, so most areas will stay completely dry. Higher storm chances are expected well to the north and east of San Antonio.

The front will crash into San Antonio between 6 and 9 a.m. Tuesday morning. Winds will strengthen behind the front, bringing dry air into the city. Sustained wind speeds of 25 to 35 mph are expected in San Antonio through the middle of the day. Gusts will be even stronger, reaching 45 to 55 mph at times.

The westerly winds will cause humidity values to plummet between 5 to 15% through much of the afternoon. That, along with the strong winds, will result in extreme fire danger across South Texas. Temperatures will also be warm, topping out in the mid- to upper 70s.

A red flag warning has been issued for all of South-Central Texas, as well as much of West Texas and the Panhandle. The high fire danger warning will stay in effect until 9 p.m. Tuesday night.

Any fires that develop could spread extremely fast and be very difficult to control. You should avoid any outdoor burning throughout the day on Tuesday. In addition, be sure to keep vehicles off of dry grass, dispose of cigarettes property, and be sure to only use grills or smokers on paved or gravel surfaces." "**Extreme fire danger, 50 mph gusts aim for South Texas Tuesday** ," San Antonio Express-News'**Anthony Franze** -- "A strong low pressure system is moving over the Desert Southwest Monday, heading east toward the Lone Star State. This weather system will provide the energy necessary to [initiate strong thunderstorms](https://substack.com/redirect/be2d14eb-9c63-49d2-9087-c57ab4183ce6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in parts of North and East Texas, as well as create extreme fire danger across much of South-Central and West Texas.

The weather system will [send a strong Pacific cold front through the region early Tuesday morning.](https://substack.com/redirect/da9c9532-dc97-4202-a416-3f034034f07e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) This front will not affect temperatures in a major way, but it will bring very strong wind speeds, along with exceptionally dry air into San Antonio on Tuesday. Together, that's a recipe for extreme fire danger.

This is not to be taken lightly. The National Weather Service said in [their area forecast discussion on Monday afternoon](https://substack.com/redirect/d07a6276-c364-41d8-90f4-7593d5a56a14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "Tuesday will feature the most extreme fire danger experienced across South Central Texas in years."

A broken line of showers and storms may occur near the San Antonio area during the predawn hours Tuesday, mainly between 4 and 8 a.m. Overall rain chances are only 20%, so most areas will stay completely dry. Higher storm chances are expected well to the north and east of San Antonio.

The front will crash into San Antonio between 6 and 9 a.m. Tuesday morning. Winds will strengthen behind the front, bringing dry air into the city. Sustained wind speeds of 25 to 35 mph are expected in San Antonio through the middle of the day. Gusts will be even stronger, reaching 45 to 55 mph at times.

The westerly winds will cause humidity values to plummet between 5 to 15% through much of the afternoon. That, along with the strong winds, will result in extreme fire danger across South Texas. Temperatures will also be warm, topping out in the mid- to upper 70s.

A red flag warning has been issued for all of South-Central Texas, as well as much of West Texas and the Panhandle. The high fire danger warning will stay in effect until 9 p.m. Tuesday night.

Any fires that develop could spread extremely fast and be very difficult to control. You should avoid any outdoor burning throughout the day on Tuesday. In addition, be sure to keep vehicles off of dry grass, dispose of cigarettes property, and be sure to only use grills or smokers on paved or gravel surfaces." | | Friend,

The Utah state legislative session is drawing to a close this week, but that didn't stop leadership from unveiling one of their biggest power grabs. With only days left, they are rushing through [S.B. 337](https://trentstaggs.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b4d3a67df0780c81313473198&id=1cb246583b&e=048116bc24) to further remove land-use authority from local city councils and planning commissions and to consolidate it in a new state government agency.

Land-use authority should remain in the hands of citizens through their local government. Over my 12 years in elected office, cities have faced an onslaught of [legislation](https://trentstaggs.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b4d3a67df0780c81313473198&id=b0d1ed2682&e=048116bc24) from the state taking our authority to decide for ourselves.

I published an [op-ed](https://trentstaggs.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b4d3a67df0780c81313473198&id=6e8c94370b&e=048116bc24) in the Deseret News over the weekend outlining what our state leaders should be doing to tackle the housing crisis while maintaining the principle of local control. _**Click on the image below to read the article.**_

Please contact your state representatives and senators this week and urge them to vote against S.B. 337 and other bills that take land-use authority away from local governments.

Yours in freedom,
Trent Staggs

| Dear Hello
Please stop by the Great American Ranch in Chesterfield tonight between 6:30pm and 8:30pm to sign the petition to get my name on the ballot.
I will also have Chase for Governor hats, shirts, sweatshirts and flags for those who stop by, while supplies last.
Many of you have pleaded with me to run for governor and promised to vote for me.
I said yes, but only if you help me. In order for you to vote for me on June 17, you must help me collect the signatures of your family and friends so that I can get on the ballot.
To even get my name on the ballot, I need at least 10,000 valid signatures, 400 in each of the 11 Congressional Districts before April 3.
That's one month.
With such little time to organize, I'm counting on the grassroots to collect the signatures. And many of you are. Thank you. Please reply to this email and let us know where you are collecting so we can best focus our efforts.
Do you want a Governor who is like Trump, one who doesn't kowtow to the political establishment and actually stands up for you?
Many of you have emphatically pleaded with me to run again stating, "We need a MAGA candidate for Governor, who we can vote for."
Many want a Trump candidate for governor.
Many of you remember that I ran for Governor in 2020-2021, for 18 months as the pro-Trump candidate.
In fact, many of you called me "Trump in Heels."
I did well in the 9 candidate ranked choice convention. I finished 3rd, ahead of a popular former Speaker of the House. Many believed that had it been a primary, that I would have won.
The Republican nomination coming up this June 17th will be a primary. I was the deciding vote in the Senate to make sure it was a primary and not a convention. Thanks to my vote, you will be able to go to your local polling location between the hours of 6am and 7pm to vote.
Unfortunately, WE CANNOT COLLECT SIGNATURES ONLINE. Signatures must be witnessed in person by signing an old fashioned paper petition ballot.
So here's the deal.
If those of you who want me to run for Governor will collect the necessary signatures to get my name on the ballot by the deadline, I will run. If not, then I won't.
This requires you to do some work:
1. Print off the attached form on one sheet of paper, front and back.
2. Witness your friends, family and neighbors sign the petition form. Please make sure they actually sign the form. Please also make sure their writing is legible so that signatures can be verified.
3. Keep in mind that you can't sign your own petition form.
4. Please collect signatures by[ Congressional District.](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001D1QG8uiLjmQpl3V3qb7D3FZKSVNLi7wJQAHmn_ZyA5msLBHcvGvGcf-V1xwHoTNUaE0ivsZugTKIDM3vdd72bS5KMrHPXDSBsD1zogAZ_La6TQIcZRGkMiviICPCi3swGbbpNd-ipyQ6xUsDtoHRODA84VniyhWB9AjUr6i_oJjkOS9pgIJQwZeZbaj6j5RqaLgBuNms7Z8=&c=V7AGsCzRW-mRZAxyN_yiD9hSBCWUdKsIXeVoyvsYHPGhKbigW9iGpQ==&ch=_Hawsi_2T25EIXTRyLsDpdxKbr3B7fRmBRmir9Pdi5gCGc7_MfO-DA==) One Congressional District per form.
5. Get the petition notarized.
6. Drop the petition off in person to: 2023 Church Street, Appomattox, VA 24522
7. Or mail the petition to:

Friends of Amanda Chase PO Box 250 Appomattox, VA 24522

If you have any questions please email Craig at craig@chaseforva.com. If you have trouble printing the forms, we can mail you the forms.
I can do this with your help. Please print off a petition now. Don't wait. Get your immediate family to sign the petition and then get your friends at church and work to sign your petition. Time is not on our side. Less than 30 days to collect signatures.

body:

---
| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8n04k8hgdbrn43d3sq1rqmvsv8lvqprq2923g60_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c1ge6p71c1h2bs)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3oh4hqnpiall48oq4v2gvq1dn51gd5tndb71g38_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c1ge6p71c1h2bs)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z22ifng7ml4v4dstoq87hsvvodhdkanpmllliggo_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c1geeo72chh2bs)

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zancoitab83hv51b1m9vrp5kktem4j99li3b493o_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c1geeo72chh2bs)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01

## 'Indiana Jones of Art' Recovers Stolen Masterpiece
Dutch police, with the help of renowned art detective Arthur Brand—dubbed the _Indiana Jones of the Art World_ —have [recovered a long-lost painting stolen](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uwyAUxfGnwRvW5cMBDwxdvKVrR-vWXGJabCzAifL2VSp17HLGn47-H9f5ijHF_faOG7kW8ixBDhwUBz17jOk56867QCRJdeSE0QKsscJ0q7OgjUEvhCI5AlwGPVpahkWMRgVtbRfdSwMFWggFYHszXjSNn1p7ixgwMA3kY8ul_8pxbyuF9Mx3Kv2Sty65tbWjMvXG5MTktKcWN6r9npicXjCTE6i_qS0n2jmW9sjlmxeqZwm4UOW3fHrkA_AnYancx4rHQVhwX4gfOcW68u2sdG5dcf54xJRivRim4bZhTL9f2n9t7k7-BAAA__8xpGXQ) from Poland’s National Museum in 1974. ## Turbulence, Power Loss Force Emergency Landings
Over the weekend, the pilots of a regional aircraft, an executive jet, and a small recreational plane were [forced to make emergency landings](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L-O4yAYBPCnwR0W4I_YFBTXuMu1V1r8-bA5YRwBjpO3X2W17XY_aaTRaP7dl7uJKeb1r9lRt1c4FsGEpGygDBZvYnov0HltmVe8Q81H4GxSN1Ddpi0oF5xX3E3cKLBBBiP9JKwcrbPOd1F_ytjAgHM5guylHQeHA4aJDQBcEWDoYztK3zZs-DI1pPfxxNK7Y--S3lp7VDL8IWImYr6uq8_WZbzqJydi_pCI-az0R5I-TK2YVyyVxvz_LOhpxScWpO0s9kyYHdIzx4aehhTXrdFwFBfzSnHHsmJ2b1pcNlyBZFNXtH9cMaVYbyMBtu4mpu917de7nlp8BQAA__-GIHBc) in Texas. ## Startup to Build 30 Nuclear Microreactors
Last Energy, a nuclear technology startup based in Washington, D.C, announced Friday it will [build 30 nuclear microreactors](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2uozAQRp8GOqPxDzEULrahu9tuiQYzTiwZjOxJCG-_Svrbf_rO0fn3M_9gTHG__8WNHL9DnhWoXoAWYOYVY7pm065ugXWULTlpjYRhvJmxfTjQN23sEKz35EFaWhZYzLBIAhUwUBvd5ww0GCl7a_quX6z2pCkMoI2RY2OA1si5dPwgpjfWkK78otL5vLXJPZiP2ug_jZoaNZ3n2QWs7PN24H59No2aRqkGK83YqGl_-kRYRGUs_DxEwsqCdir3S2zRl1wIPedSxZclVmQUnnamUtvi1uOMKcV6s42B-4YxfTX41y4vp_4HAAD__7FpZ00) in Haskell County to meet the growing energy demands of AI-driven data centers, over 340 of which are now operating in Texas. My situation is in your hands, Friend. I'm writing today to give you an update and to make a humble plea. _Look - this is from the bottom of my heart, so _please_ read this message to the end._ My team and I put together a historic win in 2021 to help flip all three of Virginia's highest offices red. Ever since becoming Lt. Governor, I've been logging big wins for my friends, neighbors, and every fellow Virginian. Now, I'm running for Governor so we can continue to keep up the amazing work we've been doing here in the Commonwealth and make history again. **But right now I have a few _SERIOUS_ challenges:**
---
**I was _legally_ barred from accepting even a dime in support of my campaign while I was in the Virginia legislative session.** But my Democrat opponent, Abigail Spanberger, has been fundraising _**BIG TIME**_ while I've been working hard in our capital. **Seriously** _**, a far-Left group injected $500K into Abigail Spanberger 's campaign coffers and there wasn't a thing I could do in response!**_

# [There were once three popes at the same time.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [World History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| Y ou’ve heard of [_The Young Pope_](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) and you’ve heard of [_The Two Popes_](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=bem9cqsjd56hf96az5dtp2gtu23rv8at05yyftjx0x0ujtqtqzc48wd3kpa1oxnid4bof19x1vdft0uij5jhkdaqql8g5880z64vo2szx6xrp6ypy5uka6j5sbsawywuc1pdl092lyujadfk5jxbjku4g6mihh8jjhff9fw16b1ojf457pbzcszwfp0wiqkrswa4n235q0gpkb600ovepsv0fr2vh360fajp57g18b90adarfveqm81ocqzzor7nms5e3b7l6lzkuihgx4qg8tcsvlrajwv8f7&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), but did you know there were once _three_ popes at the same time? The history of the papacy stretches back some 2,000 years and is full of oddities, few of which were more contentious than the Western Schism. It had its roots in the Avignon Papacy, a period that lasted from 1309 to 1376 and saw seven popes reside in Avignon rather than Rome. (Now a French prefecture, Avignon was then part of the Kingdom of Arles, which itself was part of the Holy Roman Empire.) Pope Gregory XI ended this period when he returned to Rome on January 17, 1377. After his death the following year, Romans rioted to bring about the election of a Roman pope.
---
Urban VI won, but proved so hostile to his cardinals that most of them regretted their decision and retreated to Anagni, Italy, to elect one of their own, Clement VII, as the antipope later that year. They declared Urban VI illegitimate because his election took place under duress. Clement VII resided in Avignon, with the two sides at a stalemate until the 1409 [Council of Pisa](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) elected a third pope, Alexander V, who was quickly succeeded by John XXIII following his untimely — and, according to some, conspiratorial, death the following year. Yet another [council](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) followed, this one taking place in Constance, Germany, from 1414 to 1418, ending the conflict for good. The Pisan and Avignon popes were deposed, the Roman pope agreed to resign, and [Martin V](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) was elected the one true pope.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## There have been three African popes.
The vast majority of popes have come from Italy: 217 out of 266 total. There have also been 16 from France, six from Germany, and four from Greece, which is to say the vast, _vast_ majority of popes have been European. Pope Francis, who was elected in 2013, is the first from the Americas. But he isn’t the first to hail from beyond the European continent, as there have been three [African popes](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sslllz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com): Victor I, Miltiades (also known as Melchiades), and Gelasius I. Victor I served from 189 CE to 199 CE and is believed to have been born in either Libya or Tunisia (both of which were Roman provinces). Militiades’ papacy lasted from 311 CE to 314 CE and his exact birthplace is unknown. And Gelasius I, who served from 492 CE to 496 CE, was a Roman citizen of North African descent.

clean_body: You’ve heard of The Young Pope and you’ve heard of The Two Popes, but did you know there were once three popes at the same time? | Y ou’ve heard of and you’ve heard of , but did you know there were once three popes at the same time? The history of the papacy stretches back some 2,000 years and is full of oddities, few of which were more contentious than the Western Schism. It had its roots in the Avignon Papacy, a period that lasted from 1309 to 1376 and saw seven popes reside in Avignon rather than Rome. (Now a French prefecture, Avignon was then part of the Kingdom of Arles, which itself was part of the Holy Roman Empire.) Pope Gregory XI ended this period when he returned to Rome on January 17, 1377. After his death the following year, Romans rioted to bring about the election of a Roman pope. Urban VI won, but proved so hostile to his cardinals that most of them regretted their decision and retreated to Anagni, Italy, to elect one of their own, Clement VII, as the antipope later that year. They declared Urban VI illegitimate because his election took place under duress. Clement VII resided in Avignon, with the two sides at a stalemate until the 1409 elected a third pope, Alexander V, who was quickly succeeded by John XXIII following his untimely — and, according to some, conspiratorial, death the following year. Yet another followed, this one taking place in Constance, Germany, from 1414 to 1418, ending the conflict for good. The Pisan and Avignon popes were deposed, the Roman pope agreed to resign, and was elected the one true pope. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . By the Numbers | | Popes in the history of the papacy 266 | | Dutch pope in the history of the papacy 1 | Dutch pope in the history of the papacy 1 | | Years Pius IX was pope, the longest papal reign 31 | | Days Urban VII was pope, the shortest papal reign 13 | Days Urban VII was pope, the shortest papal reign 13 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- There have been three African popes. The vast majority of popes have come from Italy: 217 out of 266 total. There have also been 16 from France, six from Germany, and four from Greece, which is to say the vast, vast majority of popes have been European. Pope Francis, who was elected in 2013, is the first from the Americas. But he isn’t the first to hail from beyond the European continent, as there have been three : Victor I, Miltiades (also known as Melchiades), and Gelasius I. Victor I served from 189 CE to 199 CE and is believed to have been born in either Libya or Tunisia (both of which were Roman provinces). Militiades’ papacy lasted from 311 CE to 314 CE and his exact birthplace is unknown. And Gelasius I, who served from 492 CE to 496 CE, was a Roman citizen of North African descent. Here is a summary of today's top stories: ****
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** HB 1131 advances in the Senate, aiming to increase Colorado State University’s veterinary program capacity to address the [state’s veterinarian shortage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The State Senate kicked off ["Buy Colorado Week"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by celebrating the 303 area code on March 3rd, promoting local businesses and economic growth. You can check all leg session updates [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Former Sen. Kevin Lundberg engaged with protesters outside a [Larimer County GOP meeting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), emphasizing Republican commitment to constitutional values and transparency. U.S. Reps. [Lauren Boebert](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [Jeff Crank](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are prioritizing accessibility, with Boebert hosting mobile office hours across Colorado’s 4th District and Crank holding his first 5th District tele-town hall on March 5. Meanwhile, Denver has seen a [sharp decline in food licenses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with high costs, wage hikes, and stringent regulations driving restaurants out of the city or out of business.

🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Sen. Marco Rubio cast doubt on the possibility of [peace between Ukraine and Russia](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), citing long-term geopolitical instability. Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz hinted at a potential [2028 presidential run](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), positioning himself as a future Democratic contender.
🗣️**Commentary Spotlight...** A [new AI tool](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) simplifies legislative bills for citizens, but concerns remain over excessive legislation and bureaucratic expansion.

This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, March 3, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Gaines: The newest use for AI? Summarizing bills so they can be understood](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_In last year’s legislative session there were 705 bills introduced, with 525 passed. I’ve not seen anything official, but the rumors I have heard have it that there are currently 200 bills in the queue for the 75th Legislature this year, with a prediction that the total number of bills could hit 600 to 700 by May._
_What spurred my looking at bill numbers this year was an email forwarded from a friend. It was a marketing email by Colorado Capitol Watch (CCW), a group that bills itself as the “the premier” bill and legislator tracking site for Colorado. The email offered a novel service: using AI to make summaries of legislation._
_Members of CCW are entitled to use their AI tool to help prepare abstracts in plain English for the bills they’re wanting to follow. This is quite a novel idea, and likely useful. Stacking the confusion of untangling legalese on top of bill numbers like we’ve seen the last two years (and likely more to come), would indeed make an assist welcome._

**[State Senate celebrates 3/3 — a tip of the hat to the original 303 area code — in kickoff of ‘Buy Colorado Week’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Senate passed a resolution declaring March 3 as "Buy Colorado Day" and March 3-10 as "Buy Colorado Week," celebrating the state's businesses and economic contributions.
* The resolution highlights Colorado’s 700,000 small businesses and major industries, including agriculture, craft brewing, and manufacturing, while also noting the state's challenging regulatory environment.
* Lawmakers encouraged residents to support local businesses, emphasizing that Colorado has been the birthplace of iconic products like Crocs and Coors, despite growing economic hurdles.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[In fix to vet shortage, HB 1131 will graduate more vets, CSU dean says as measure advances in Senate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* HB 1131, which passed the House unanimously and advanced in the Senate, aims to address Colorado's veterinary shortage by lifting enrollment caps at Colorado State University's veterinary program.
* The bill received backing from both parties, with lawmakers emphasizing its free-market approach to increasing the number of veterinarians, particularly in rural areas.
* If enacted, the measure would take effect 90 days after the legislative session adjourns, potentially allowing CSU to expand its veterinary class size by the fall semester.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**['We’re freedom-loving Americans,’ former Sen. Lundberg said after Larimer Co. GOP meeting protested](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former Sen. Kevin Lundberg engaged with protesters outside a Larimer County GOP meeting, defending the Republican commitment to constitutional values and free speech.
* The protest, organized by left-wing activists, accused the GOP of extremism, while Lundberg pushed back, arguing that government overreach in Colorado is a greater threat.
* Despite tensions, Lundberg and other attendees reaffirmed their support for conservative principles and grassroots activism in the state.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[Why are so many Denver restaurants going belly up or moving out of the city?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver has seen a 24% drop in restaurant food licenses since 2023, with rising costs, labor expenses, and regulatory challenges driving closures or relocations to the suburbs.
* The city's high minimum wage ($15.79/hr for tipped workers, $18.81 for others) is cited as a major strain on restaurant owners, along with increasing utility, rent, and insurance costs.
* Lawmakers are proposing House Bill 1208, which aims to reduce financial burdens on restaurants by adjusting wage structures, though it could result in lower pay for tipped employees.

This bill, which would enable public-to-public School Choice, already passed the House with overwhelming support. **Now, its fate rests in the hands of two key figures: Senator Dennis DeBar and Lieutenant Governor Delbert Hosemann.** **_If they throw their support behind HB1435, they will be heroes._**

**_Dennis DeBar & Delbert Hosemann are responsible for the fate of HB1435._**
| Mississippi stands at a crossroads. We are now surrounded by states—Arkansas, Alabama, Tennessee, and Louisiana—where parents already enjoy the freedom that School Choice provides. Yet here, we remain behind.

Just last week, President Trump issued a powerful call to action, urging states like ours to step up and pass legislation like HB1435. He’s counting on our elected officials to champion this cause.

**The question now is clear: Will our Senators stand with President Trump and the families of Mississippi, or will they side with the progressive activists fighting against School Choice?**

We’ll have our answer today, and I’ll make sure to keep you informed as events unfold.

body:
Most Christians don’t realize this...| | | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=cbfad1cc176846ddaf56de34de42b1a6&_e=1RoaoSK9C8de4ayS2xF_2J9D-wdDJ6_qx26c_Qcq_zl1MeeV8UhTwellubHFbtunQBnXPiHuZuj4pFQBFwMOpu2YDo7zvDANBs53HkGD8oDJqhc9NiOy43mjCmstpr4D3eA4y7rFyQ9x-4Z2gCuYHjeavlTv0t9xQRJO1gsZmYbzlVTqXHoyRZ_TmluPkOmb85LzPEeMabxTdRXPoV30Bko8KLQ8hO9rJxHZkPacFRYCRHdw4ZhD0HR7SyIfR8VCBt-_P_rT4UHmvhgMg8xz7ZVwPUZSwR9SFOhyXFBta46w7d8Nlbk8w7eWNKvL_1Kv)
---
Peter, This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life . . . yet most Christians in America don't know anything about it! **The last, and strongest, line of legal defense for Christians in the United States may soon be destroyed by ideological activists, with a regulatory change being considered in ALL 50 states.** That could make critical legal victories for Americans of faith--like protection of **personal prayer** without getting fired, protection of **moral conscience** so you can't be forced to dispense abortion-inducing drugs, and even protection of students forming a **Christian student club** --IMPOSSIBLE to pursue . . . . . . and leave Christians and Americans of faith, alongside religious ministries, nonprofits, and schools, without ANY legal defense when they wrongly and unconstitutionally face threats or punishment for their biblical values! **Peter, Christian Legal Society, a fellowship, ministry, and legal defense organization since 1961, is leading the fight to protect Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, state by state.** _**[_**Against a well-organized, well-funded opposition, we're counting on the support of generous Americans of faith like you to stand with us. Would you consider a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help support Christian Legal Society in this critical work?**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=cbfad1cc176846ddaf56de34de42b1a6&_e=1RoaoSK9C8de4ayS2xF_2J9D-wdDJ6_qx26c_Qcq_zl1MeeV8UhTwellubHFbtunQBnXPiHuZuj4pFQBFwMOpu2YDo7zvDANBs53HkGD8oDJqhc9NiOy43mjCmstpr4D3eA4y7rFyQ9x-4Z2gCuYHjeavlTv0t9xQRJO1gsZmYYo3EjuDiVNT4fATj62pqTtW06G2vRyvOvuP12aLMYZosfC_YbenIT2oox9Z2ofX9OGMNyevyFYeEWheiyy26wbVzPlcnbRt1Grq2xv0qro_RUC7Y7epve4jGLW4JqUlwZhy-a-LDy9sI-5WCgOREn_)**_
---
[**Support Christian Legal Society**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=cbfad1cc176846ddaf56de34de42b1a6&_e=1RoaoSK9C8de4ayS2xF_2J9D-wdDJ6_qx26c_Qcq_zl1MeeV8UhTwellubHFbtunQBnXPiHuZuj4pFQBFwMOpu2YDo7zvDANBs53HkGD8oDJqhc9NiOy43mjCmstpr4D3eA4y7rFyQ9x-4Z2gCuYHjeavlTv0t9xQRJO1gsZmYaO-gbH4uGIBPvt86_3eDW7Ykz672oMPHa6UIrY3eJhSeJbfuxcwMYJSD1tKnIkTLvyXkv5AzpONhwyymboan5IWPa3aWL796TisIYFZYx4roxu3gU3VqhehPhZKjc_cz6khIrHBCjiVlDnzxF4UDNd)
---
For those who don't work in law offices, the rule change I'm discussing may sound boring or unremarkable: it's known as Model Rule 8.4(g) from the American Bar Association. **But its impact has devastating real-world consequences for Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, as the silencing and punishment of Christian attorneys --and the faithful Americans they would otherwise defend--seems to be the sole goal of this rule change.** Without any examples of why it's needed . . . without any response to the 400+ comments and letters of concern submitted by all attorneys concerned with free speech, the American Bar Association offered no response to rightful concerns that radical activists could use this to:
* **discourage or punish attorneys** from sharing political, social, or religious viewpoints that are outside the current political orthodoxy (today, that's typically defined as "progressive" or "Woke");

* **stop attorneys from volunteering at their churches,** sitting on church boards, or serving schools they've gone to, if those schools are Christian or otherwise religious;

* **prevent attorneys from serving in Christian ministries** , no matter how much good work those ministries do in their communities; and

* **put an end to Christian attorneys doing pro bono work** **to defend religious freedom** on behalf of Christian ministries, nonprofits, or schools that proudly proclaim their commitment to biblical values!

**Peter, there is still time to stop this rule from taking root in America . . . but it requires a 50-state strategy and a major investment of time, talent, and legal work.** Christian Legal Society has led the charge on this important issue since it was first raised in 2015. But to make sure we WIN this fight--and preserve religious freedom and protection for Christian attorneys and, by extension, all Americans of faith--I'm counting on your support. _**[_**Can I count on your generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help Christian Legal Society save these critical protections for Christian attorneys . . . and every ministry, nonprofit, or believer that those same attorneys would defend?**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=cbfad1cc176846ddaf56de34de42b1a6&_e=1RoaoSK9C8de4ayS2xF_2J9D-wdDJ6_qx26c_Qcq_zl1MeeV8UhTwellubHFbtunQBnXPiHuZuj4pFQBFwMOpu2YDo7zvDANBs53HkGD8oDJqhc9NiOy43mjCmstpr4D3eA4y7rFyQ9x-4Z2gCuYHjeavlTv0t9xQRJO1gsZmYaywrE2qCksCgiXYBNPZ7y6pIFSnYskZhAEqlch_Kw1gekKilmlODLbQJAMlOwGWJHF56EvJe7iPpG-n3OfsH9PEOzBo0NwT3g6XY7KFWSe4CThqOUC1wYWikgtM_Qwa0y4pazMxYmtA-K_saHwtJAo)**_
---
[**Support Christian Legal Society**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=cbfad1cc176846ddaf56de34de42b1a6&_e=1RoaoSK9C8de4ayS2xF_2J9D-wdDJ6_qx26c_Qcq_zl1MeeV8UhTwellubHFbtunQBnXPiHuZuj4pFQBFwMOpu2YDo7zvDANBs53HkGD8oDJqhc9NiOy43mjCmstpr4D3eA4y7rFyQ9x-4Z2gCuYHjeavlTv0t9xQRJO1gsZmYaWswgVPEiIOvh0Wb-FXo-UVKDdjyrcoUiZNqFcYumNUbal2hgTejzqM0dzFpWfWptgooHEt1XSfqaeupvZPrM7Rn-9dYQtZ3VzC6MUTPusdrChHQymmh5ig2s8qF73whF3oh7cmvuJN4sYkpu-U7qr)
---
Since 1961, Christian Legal Society has been a fellowship of Christians dedicated to serving Jesus Christ through the practice and study of law, the defense of religious freedom and life, and the provision of legal aid to the needy. And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society's Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced all Americans' inalienable rights to religious freedom and life in the public square. **No other organization is leading the charge to defend Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith on this critical issue like Christian Legal Society.** _**[That's why I encourage you--and hope--that you'll make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now to help Christian Legal Society WIN critical victories in the battles still to come.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=cbfad1cc176846ddaf56de34de42b1a6&_e=1RoaoSK9C8de4ayS2xF_2J9D-wdDJ6_qx26c_Qcq_zl1MeeV8UhTwellubHFbtunQBnXPiHuZuj4pFQBFwMOpu2YDo7zvDANBs53HkGD8oDJqhc9NiOy43mjCmstpr4D3eA4y7rFyQ9x-4Z2gCuYHjeavlTv0t9xQRJO1gsZmYYENAOeasyEdgUqeGf-BjIxIXjFxByqrU9F5pDWohZsDgxTxw0hI00HQlgyl4I7F8Py2lEYDu6J03d3US5nZ5RXguJCfRukfYT-ZRrjbxOmZ0d3lUwvKh8FKSd7WcT_NNfA3pUWk30_Ggzuf3Xp9PBJ)**_ Thank you for your support and for your prayerful consideration. David Nammo
Executive Director & CEO
Christian Legal Society

## _This Morning 's Debate:_
National Security Advisor Mike Waltz **[fired back at CNN's Dana Bash](https://substack.com/redirect/5ebddec7-0c5a-49d7-a1a1-e8390e72b9ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for attacking the way President Trump and Vice President Vance "treated Zelensky" during the heated Oval Office meeting last week.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/5ebddec7-0c5a-49d7-a1a1-e8390e72b9ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5ebddec7-0c5a-49d7-a1a1-e8390e72b9ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"You compared him (Zelensky) to an ex-girlfriend who wants to argue over everything you said 9 years ago rather than moving forward," Bash told Waltz. "Is that really how you see it now and do you see at all the perspective he was trying to put out there which is that he does not trust Vladimir Putin and he just feels he needs some kind of security guarantees?"
**[Waltz made his position perfectly clear,](https://substack.com/redirect/5ebddec7-0c5a-49d7-a1a1-e8390e72b9ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "The President is trying to end this war! He campaigned on it and he was elected on it. It is going to take tough diplomacy. But you have Democrats who are criticizing us for dealing with the Russians. These are the same Democrats who had no problem dealing with the murderous Iranian regime in an Iran deal that was horrific and used the Russians as intermediaries!"
He continued, refusing to be interrupted, "I think you've got one of those Senators coming on your show next! So I'm finding the hypocritical pearl clutching in Washington DC ridiculous!"

# Trump threatens to cut federal funds to schools allowing "illegal protests"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/677170eb-7f79-4e7b-ae35-b600f33558bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Donald Trump vowed Tuesday to cut federal funding to U.S. schools and colleges that allow "illegal protests," specifically targeting those he says harass Jewish students. Speaking at Mar-a-Lago, Trump condemned pro-Palestinian campus demonstrations, asserting they breach civil rights laws by promoting antisemitic behavior.
"All Federal Funding will STOP for any College, School, or University that allows illegal protests," Trump **[wrote in a Truth Social post.](https://substack.com/redirect/3666a006-8797-42c4-8142-19ec4c6a1b36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "Agitators will be imprisoned/or permanently sent back to the country from which they came. American students will be permanently expelled or, depending on the crime, arrested."
Trump's warning comes after his administration threatened to pull $50 million in federal contracts from the Ivy League Columbia University due to the school's alleged inaction on controlling sometimes destructive and violent anti-Israel protests on campus.
Trump previously signed an executive order instructing federal agencies to find ways to crack down on pro-Hamas intimidation tactics such as graffitti, including on college campuses. The order also enables the deportation of pro-Hamas students who break laws during demonstrations.

Republicans nationwide are working to raise money, increase resources, and ensure we WIN in FL-01 and FL-06, but **[we need your support.](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=b4ad8bfd52a640e6a07fe1b8e2eb09fa&_e=KYfxQETokcqUR37c9XYrq_2brHbQWZFdPVP0Jmb4T4hnOH6yh59mj8-KndxFCIYo8x9hapHhSjssiMaAnzoCDoBRY_MePICWWAdXqbNEbJJvtbeOJJJbY3FfrvcvDC5_ow86j0iadu2qHm3ruaeo_hm5XGV8fngUbcz2BaHODhl2FY9Uu8q7e_SRaXMy0qsK6jSmsQFj3befro4HcKn12FbSpX6x70bS_QZHHaQAUuENC4TY0kDI-fjojNBZrb-QMHSNCq6g0670_6m_4Nf3TNuWvHRe_AEvrg7_Lt7BRe9yMaV87xDgdDmupLWbApYAvR6pml9Dvf_6CnCaeLXl_Q%3D%3D)** _Everything we worked for and earned in 2024 is on the line._ We can't lose it all in the early moments of 2025.

Hi. I bet that's not what you were expecting on a big red hat these days

_(But don 't you worry, I'm about as pro-Trump as they come!)_

_My name 's Marlin Stutzman._ I'm a 4th-generation farmer raising the finest Wagyu cows this side of the Mississippi. When I'm not herding cattle and hauling hay, I'm fighting the good fight in the People's House.

I ran for office because the Democrats AND even some Republicans have stabbed farmers like me in the back for as long as I can remember.

Ask any farmer - they'll show you the scars.

**I swear elites in DC think meat and produce *magically appear* at Whole Foods - not because farmers devote their blood, sweat, and tears to their trade. **

That's how they can sleep at night knowing...
* China is buying up our farmland
* Democrats taxed us into oblivion
* Liberals want to replace beef with fake meat made from God knows what
* Politicians get rich at our expense
* We're left to pick up the scraps

My entire life is focused on bringing all that to a screeching halt. And the political class knows I can't be bought off or bribed. That's why they're mobilizing the powers-at-be to silence me so they can keep the gravy train rolling.

_And holding the line here will be tougher than a $3 steak._

**[That's why I'm left with no choice but to ask you for a small donation today to keep me in Congress. Peter,
Throughout our nation’s history, we have seen far-right leaders go to extraordinary lengths to bypass democratic principles — _all in their relentless pursuit of power._
From onerous voting requirements to partisan and racial gerrymanders that allow politicians to choose their voters, they have systematically worked to undermine the fundamental right of Americans to have their voices heard at the ballot box.

## Abandoning Our Allies Is Part 1
Trump's foreign policy is defined by betrayal, abandoning America's allies while prioritizing racial favoritism in immigration.
For example, in 2019 he withdrew U.S. troops from northern Syria, leaving defenseless the Kurdish allies who had fought Daesh extremists alongside American forces. This, after promising in 2018 that he would never forget how the Kurds helped us and would always stand by them.
Last month he blocked over 1,600 vetted Afghan refugees--who risked their lives aiding U.S. forces against the Taliban--while granting priority refugee status to white Afrikaner South Africans (who by the way rejected Trump's absurd proposal).
Now, his White House ambush on Zelenskyy is just the latest clear declaration that he is retreating from U.S. commitments to Ukraine. This reckless act undermines the 1994 Budapest Memorandum and emboldens Russia.
In 2014 a prominent politician declared on the U.S. Senate floor:
> One of the most important things we can do to help Ukraine protect its sovereignty and transition to democracy is to help them with their defense capabilities. When the Soviet Union fell in the early 1990s, Ukraine was left with the world's third-largest stockpile of nuclear weapons. But they signed an agreement with the United States, the United Kingdom, and Russia, stating that if they gave up their nuclear weapons, these three countries would provide for their defense and assure their security. Ukraine upheld their end of the agreement and gave up these weapons. [Author's _Note: This is the Budapest Memorandum_]
> That agreement was signed in 1994. Now, 20 years later, one of those three countries has not only failed to provide for Ukraine's defense but has invaded them. Think about what message this sends to other countries that feel threatened by their neighbors. The United States and the free world tells South Korea, Japan, and Saudi Arabia not to develop nuclear weapons because we will protect them. But after seeing what happened to Ukraine, what kind of lesson does this send?
> I think the message to many nations is that they can no longer count on the security promises made by the free world.
Who was that prominent politician? None other than current Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who sat silent like a petulant child as Trump and Vance berated Zelenskyy, and then had the audacity to subsequently tweet, "_Thank you POTUS for standing up for America in a way that no President has ever had the courage to do before. Thank you for putting America First. America is with you_!"
Rubio is right about one thing--no previous POTUS has so brazenly supported Putin in violation of the Budapest Memorandum, putting the lives of countless people at risk. Ultimately, each of these aforementioned reckless reversals make clear that under Trump, America's word means nothing, leaving allies stranded and global security in free fall. But moreover, these acts are just part of the more sinister plan at play that many in corporate media are ignoring. A devastating reality we must confront on its face if we have any hope of stopping its advancement.

## Trump Is Preparing To Commit Mass War Crimes
Imagine a politician committing the following acts:
* Fire more than 17 inspectors general, who are independent watchdogs specifically empowered to oversee government waste, fraud and abuse.1
* Fire the Air Force, Army, and Navy's top judge advocates general, who are legally responsible to ensure all commanders follow the Uniform Code of Military Justice.2
* Fire the Joint Chiefs chairman, which is the Navy's top officer and Air Force vice chief, also responsible to ensure the Uniform Code of Military Justice is followed.3
* Fire and prosecute the FBI agents who worked on prosecuting the January 6 insurrectionists, while issuing a blanket pardon for the January 6 insurrectionists.4
* Shut down the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, which exists to prevent billion dollar banks and corporations from exploiting consumers or using funds to commit illegal acts domestically and internationally.5
* Shut down USAID, a critical life line for tens of millions globally, and a vital department to prevent violence and turmoil, especially in developing nations.6
* Shut down US Institute for Peace, a vital organization built to resolve conflicts through diplomacy rather than through war or conflict.7
* Sign an EO that makes independent regulators at the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Federal Trade Commission, and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation accountable to the White House, not to their respective agency heads.8
* Order US Cyber Command to halt all cyber operations against Russia, and in defense of Russia, exposing the United States to cyber attack from Russia.9
* Require a loyalty test for all federal law enforcement officials, and fire those who refuse to put loyalty to Trump above loyalty to the United States Constitution.10
* Build a concentration camp on foreign soil to house at least 30,000 people11, while passing legislation (The Laken Riley Act) which allows indefinite incarceration of migrants merely accused of a crime without affording them due process of law as our Constitution requires.12

This list is not comprehensive, but you get the picture. Such a politician who:
* abandons our allies
* consolidates power from independent regulatory agencies
* shuts down watch dog regulatory agencies
* terminates military officers and inspectors general who exist solely to ensure military law and regulatory law is followed,
* eliminates organizations who exist to prevent conflict,
* eliminates organizations who prevent financial fraud,
* eliminates actions to prevent cyber attacks
* prosecutes those who prosecuted actual insurrectionists, and
* builds concentration camps to house 'undesirable' people

...is a politician who is preparing for war and to commit war crimes. And to be sure, all of the above is not hypothetical--this is exactly what Trump has _already_ done in his first ~40 days in office. This is the deeper sinister plan clearly at work and advancing daily. The Trump/Vance ambush of Zelenskyy is not an anomaly, it is party of a calculated strategy to further desensitize Americans to our international obligations, to shift the Overton window and normalize divisiveness over diplomacy, and to lay the groundwork to commit war crimes without accountability.

## Conclusion
I wrote this to document these ongoing atrocities and ensure the American people are aware of what is to come, so we can hopefully build an effective counter-response. My fury is at GOP leadership for continuing to enable this fascism, and my frustration (also fury?) is at Democratic leadership for failing to meet the moment. Even in response to the Trump/Vance ambush on Zelenskyy, all Minority Leader Jeffries could surmise was, "_We need to see some mature leadership from the Trump administration. Democrats in the House and Senate will urge this breach be repaired_."
The man is preparing to commit mass war crimes, and the Democratic leadership's response is effectively, "_Let 's be mature about this or you leave us absolutely no choice but to ask you again politely to be mature about this_." I am sorry but this is what failing to meet the moment looks like.
Tonight is Donald Trump's State of the Union address. Look for my analysis shortly thereafter to highlight and factcheck the disinformation he will no doubt spew. And as you watch Trump and his sycophants break down international alliances, terminate regulatory agencies, and fire those responsible to uphold military law, understand the goal. It is not to "make government more efficient and capable," it's to make government _ineffective_ and _incapable_ of upholding Constitutional and international law, and to sell it to the highest oligarch bidder. This is the reality we face, and it is critical we stand united as Americans of all faiths, colors, creeds--and political parties--to stop this fascism in its tracks. Indeed, fascism is a one way street, and once our nation goes down that road, there's no coming back. We cannot let that happen.

body:
Later tonight, Donald Trump will deliver a major speech to millions of people across the country.
#

Friends --
Later tonight, Donald Trump will deliver a major speech to a joint session of Congress -- and to millions of people across the country.
By now, we have a pretty good sense of what we will hear from the president.
But what about what we won't hear?
Will we hear that guns are the leading cause of death for children in the United States?
Will we hear that firearms kill more than 46,000 people a year in this country?
We hear about the hundreds of billions of dollars in lost economic activity gun violence causes in this country?
Will we hear about the importance of investing in mental health, like Republicans are so fond of talking about after every mass shooting?
Will we hear about the millions of women in the United States who have been threatened with a gun by an abusive partner, and how we plan to keep them safe?
Will we hear about strengthening our background checks system -- the one issue in America supported by the vast majority of Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike?
No. We probably won't hear about any of those things from Donald Trump.
But that is what makes the work we do at GIFFORDS important. Because even if the president won't talk about gun safety, we're working every day in Washington DC and state legislatures across the country to strengthen and protect our gun laws to create a safer country.
But that work is not possible without your financial support. So before President Trump speaks, we're asking:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS today? We will put your donation to work making our communities safer from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar25.KlmT7F&refcode=em250304-1-b&t=1&akid=10074%2E3935704%2EVTMpLz)

name: Able Dems
subject: Republicans aim to roll back same-sex marriage equality
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Able Dems PAC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
| | | Hi Friend, My name is Jeff, and I’m reaching out to you as the founder of Able Dems, an organization dedicated to electing Democrats with disabilities and our allies. As a proud member of the disability community, I have experienced firsthand the struggle against marginalization. I know how vital it is to have a seat at the table where decisions that affect our lives are made. Today, I am asking for your support in another critical fight that impacts not just me, but countless individuals across the nation. Right now, Republicans in nine states are mounting efforts to overturn _Obergefell v. Hodges_ , the landmark 2015 Supreme Court decision that legalized marriage equality nationwide. They are pushing measures that threaten to strip away fundamental rights, including my right as a gay man to marry the person I love. In states like Idaho and North Dakota, resolutions calling for the Supreme Court to overturn this decision have already passed one chamber of the state legislature. Meanwhile, states such as Missouri and Oklahoma are introducing bills aimed at creating inequality in marriage rights, specifically targeting same-sex couples. This isn’t merely a political issue; it’s deeply personal and profoundly impactful. It affects real people and real families, many of whom risk losing their homes, healthcare, and safety. _We must act now to protect our rights and those of future generations._ **Able Dems is steadfast in our commitment to resist this wave of discrimination and cruelty, but we cannot do it alone.** [**I urge you to consider donating to Able Dems today. clean_body: | | | Hi Friend, My name is Jeff, and I’m reaching out to you as the founder of Able Dems, an organization dedicated to electing Democrats with disabilities and our allies. As a proud member of the disability community, I have experienced firsthand the struggle against marginalization. I know how vital it is to have a seat at the table where decisions that affect our lives are made. Today, I am asking for your support in another critical fight that impacts not just me, but countless individuals across the nation. Right now, Republicans in nine states are mounting efforts to overturn Obergefell v. Hodges , the landmark 2015 Supreme Court decision that legalized marriage equality nationwide. They are pushing measures that threaten to strip away fundamental rights, including my right as a gay man to marry the person I love. In states like Idaho and North Dakota, resolutions calling for the Supreme Court to overturn this decision have already passed one chamber of the state legislature. Meanwhile, states such as Missouri and Oklahoma are introducing bills aimed at creating inequality in marriage rights, specifically targeting same-sex couples. This isn’t merely a political issue; it’s deeply personal and profoundly impactful. It affects real people and real families, many of whom risk losing their homes, healthcare, and safety. We must act now to protect our rights and those of future generations. Able Dems is steadfast in our commitment to resist this wave of discrimination and cruelty, but we cannot do it alone. **If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. ** Together, we can make a difference and ensure that everyone has a seat at the table. Thank you for standing with us in this crucial fight. -Jeff Person, Founder, Able Dems | elects Democrats with disabilities. Dear Peter, We kicked off February with staff training, equipping our team to serve you better. Thirty staff members participated, covering everything from core doctrines to our 2025 vision and essential administrative insights. Let’s continue seeking God and engaging the church in meaningful ways. Here’s to a month filled with purpose and faith!
---
---
We also had the privilege of hosting our monthly Freedom Night in America, featuring our CEO, Charlie Kirk, alongside special guests Cliffe and Stuart Knechtle. This was our largest Freedom Night yet, with over 2,400 people in attendance! # [Tell Elon Musk to keep his hands off Social Security!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T03dc55fa-b9ab-4e5e-8561-65b9ee0d0d43/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Elon Musk continues to wreak havoc on our government, slashing important programs he knows nothing about and firing employees at will. Now he's going after Social Security, spreading lies on social media about this essential service that millions of Americans rely on, and treating it like a plaything for half-baked experiments. Musk made completely bogus claims that millions of people over the age of 130 were receiving Social Security checks (not true) and called Social Security a "Ponzi scheme" and "the biggest fraud in the history of humanity." He's also working with Trump to make massive staffing cuts to the Social Security Administration – which will likely result in checks being delayed – or not showing up at all. The richest person in the world has no right to go after the essential benefits that Americans worked their whole lives to pay into. [**Sign your name to demand Elon Musk keep his hands off our Social Security >> **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8e95ecbc-ac6a-47fd-8fb8-0b388641d024/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Being the youngest woman in the 119th Congress, I am proud to carry this legacy forward and bring a new generation’s perspective on pressing issues like reproductive rights, climate change, and the cost of childcare. Our fight is far from over. The Trump Administration and the GOP are waging a war against women’s rights and the LGBTQ+ community, and it’s imperative that we meet this moment with deliberate and fervent action. clean_body: United We Dream Action is amplifying immigrants’ voices and sharing resources to keep our communities safe and well-informed. | | | Peter — We need to have each other’s backs, especially as the Trump administration cruelly targets immigrant communities. That’s why our team put together Know Your Rights resources for immigrant communities across the nation: to make sure people have the information and resources they need to protect themselves. Here’s the good news: our information campaigns are working. Trump officials are complaining that immigrants are too well-informed about their rights. We need to keep up the work. For the next four years, we’re going to be fighting a battle on so many different fronts: Stopping unlawful detentions and deportations, protecting our asylum systems, organizing against anti-immigrant legislation, and more. My understanding is that Democrats would lose approximately 20 seats in the house if illegals were not counted in census. And that’s also 20 less electoral votes for president.**** ** **So, illegals absolutely do impact who controls the House and the presidency.”****~** Elon Musk
---
| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=247d537f40644abe96e84a653e2cd679&_e=ntqiZoLuC3Kt9yzmyV_f1O6EabJsf58qwvw9l0WfgCCsqeJUAU7I7jGXDcPXYxywSPmjIuIkifYywto2v8yMY5cYDJvy_3CuloQ72UQ1sDy8HvZjJ83LH1KBYxk93HvPmZiz6o1kRhPWXo4c0X5vXT1r344gm1NirIuqwSM0_3JXbUI1FhtHy1wAeU3nO0WallQRsWzlHvGRzK9gGrSsiPPWYL5uMIApyjUVXBS386UvTgKmx55-CP9v9jupOCetbh_9XxFf8LLoGVlXkzJt0WI-bIkRq8DYPMCEBk0n0YiD_4ujW227tP_Z-m9Me_yed4p6Tkpc90MKcqFLdNR9ruz2PMiaH1tzvYfcbG2jeVQ7RTC065NqssF39-AhQhom)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=247d537f40644abe96e84a653e2cd679&_e=ntqiZoLuC3Kt9yzmyV_f1O6EabJsf58qwvw9l0WfgCCsqeJUAU7I7jGXDcPXYxywSPmjIuIkifYywto2v8yMY5cYDJvy_3CuloQ72UQ1sDy8HvZjJ83LH1KBYxk93HvPmZiz6o1kRhPWXo4c0X5vXT1r344gm1NirIuqwSM0_3JXbUI1FhtHy1wAeU3nO0WallQRsWzlHvGRzK9gGrSsiOdkfWsopAeRjSkIP-kYZCjebO-oZUVuh1vl7LNzgOcAY6BjWu5NTiw_gVLTfd2dGdFQ8fkUqoWyEU3uy1-RPzX9FUW2kigN8wYLyo5bHo9OuKJjpGQESegPKd69qldXmnyEsQ-4yjny1DI8k-mXlOEXB1NuvF8yTf4bW0tSwlGr)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you.
