Mardi Gras predates American celebrations of St. Patrick's Day, Memorial Day, Labor Day, and, yes, Independence Day. The French brought Mardi Gras to Louisiana, where it has been celebrated uninterrupted for more than 325 years.
Mesoscale News with Rebekah Jones is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..gzbU7Fc5LgGfMZYJx_D0r_ESQnm6l52RrgJ2ilpn9IQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=158370880)
More than an[ historic relic,](https://substack.com/redirect/8f970a95-b638-410f-bf74-6569e8ddc67f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) though, Mardi Gras is personal for those of us who grew up along the stretch of Gulf Coast from Galveston to Gulf Shores. Even more so for the French-speaking communities still there.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e6ff1e41-9d99-456d-8465-042d20ffc588?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The communities maintaining the French-Native languages and history today are those in the remote areas of South Louisiana -- those most vulnerable to marginal changes in the tides, currents and sea level. Those who suffer most during a catastrophic storm. Those who have[ long suffered ](https://substack.com/redirect/00ee6aad-6bb7-4415-a807-19fffcfbf056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)at the hands of a government who does not care for their existence, and corporations who would erase them.
The application for federal recognition is grueling. I know because I helped three tribes work on [documenting their geographic ancestry](https://substack.com/redirect/cbc85d67-d058-49fd-9904-75a371d5f849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in pursuit of the BIA's coveted stamp of approval (and resources).
[_[If accessing the story map, click"cancel" twice when prompted to sign in](https://substack.com/redirect/cbc85d67-d058-49fd-9904-75a371d5f849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_]
For over a week now, tribal leaders [have been testifying ](https://substack.com/redirect/fa99b129-6cb0-4d61-990e-0dbcbb08cda6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in appropriation hearings over potential (and major) funding cuts to the already-stressed BIA.
Though not as salacious as cuts to critical resources for weather modeling and disaster response, the potential cuts to the BIA threaten the very existence of these tribal nations.
"Cuts do not save significant money, but cause real harm to tribal communities," said Chippewa Cree Tribe chairman Harlan Baker last Tuesday.
Concern that BIA funding and programs fall under Trump's "DEI" crusade, Tribal leaders expressed fear over cuts to critical cultural programs that seek to maintain and restore indigenous histories, language and lands.
More immediately, cuts to Medicare would devastate Native communities and health facilities, as [more than 50%](https://substack.com/redirect/308af374-d6c5-40ce-8d29-3910006469b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of non-Hispanic Native Americans rely on public health insurance.
Not to mention those most-impacted by the effects of climate change, like discontinued HUD funding for tribal relocation in South Louisiana.
The 10% budget increase for the BIA last year, approved during President Biden's tenure, specifically addresses climate resilience. When Trump's executive order freezing all funding for climate programs went out in January, climate-related grants from other agencies[ were frozen](https://substack.com/redirect/8eceb15a-470d-45c0-9dd6-92f628a3bd42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), too.
The entire BIA's budget is $1.5 billion -- and that's split across the [574 federally-recognized tribes in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/f0884378-b1e4-4ede-a8a5-572b55bb4300?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Tribes that are not [federally recognized](https://substack.com/redirect/4b35a3c0-0dc4-466c-9f44-b2300e31b630?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but may have state, county or local status, get very little form the federal government outside of social services funding.
For example, South Louisiana only has one federally recognized tribe -- the Chitimacha (they're also the first tribe to ever be recognized).
But the state of Louisiana [recognizes](https://substack.com/redirect/dcd512bc-3243-4fb0-9286-5e9765eab977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) six tribes in the Southeast portion of the state alone that are not recognized by the BIA.
Those tribes maintain the French-Native history, language and culture that we celebrate today. Some of those who live along the bayous still speak French exclusively.
That's where I learned to speak French (and why my French sounds much different than what you would hear in France, Canada or Guinea).
Please consider contacting your congressional representative and tell them to protect tribal communities.
[Click here to find your representative](https://substack.com/redirect/b3c93a8e-9ffa-4c8d-a9c9-910a3b523b7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
_En Francais_
Le Mardi Gras precede les celebrations americaines de la fete de la Saint-Patrick, du Memorial Day, de la fete du Travail et, oui, de l'Independence Day. Les Francais ont apporte le Mardi Gras en Louisiane, ou il est celebre sans interruption depuis plus de 325 ans.
Cependant, au-dela d'une simple relique historique, le Mardi Gras est personnel pour ceux d'entre nous qui ont grandi le long de la cote du Golfe, de Galveston a Gulf Shores. Encore plus pour les communautes francophones qui y vivent encore.
Les communautes qui preservent aujourd'hui les langues et l'histoire franco-Amerindiennes sont celles des zones reculees du sud de la Louisiane - celles qui sont les plus vulnerables aux changements marginaux des marees, des courants et du niveau de la mer. Celles qui souffrent le plus lors d'une tempete catastrophique. Celles qui ont[ longtemps souffert](https://substack.com/redirect/0a5c1140-3ca7-489b-bf3f-213457535483?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) de l'indifference d'un gouvernement qui ne se soucie pas de leur existence, et de la part de societes qui chercheraient a les effacer.
La demande de reconnaissance federale est eprouvante. Je le sais, car j'ai aide trois tribus a documenter leur[ ascendance geographique](https://substack.com/redirect/cbc85d67-d058-49fd-9904-75a371d5f849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) dans le cadre de la quete du precieux tampon d'approbation (et des ressources) de la BIA.
[S _[i vous accedez a la carte interactive, cliquez sur "annuler" deux fois lorsqu'on vous demande de vous connecter](https://substack.com/redirect/cbc85d67-d058-49fd-9904-75a371d5f849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_]
Depuis plus d'une semaine, les dirigeants tribaux temoignent lors des audiences de l'appropriation des fonds concernant les potentielles (et importantes) reductions des financements deja sous pression de la BIA.
Bien que moins sensationnelles que les reductions des ressources essentielles pour la modelisation des conditions meteorologiques et la reponse aux catastrophes, les coupures potentielles a la BIA menacent l'existence meme de ces nations tribales.
"Les reductions ne permettent pas d'economiser de l'argent de maniere significative, mais causent de reels prejudices aux communautes tribales", a declare le president de la tribu Chippewa Cree, Harlan Baker, mardi dernier.
Preoccupes que les financements et programmes de la BIA tombent sous la croisade "DEI" de Trump, les dirigeants tribaux ont exprime leur crainte face aux coupures des programmes culturels essentiels qui cherchent a maintenir et restaurer les histoires, les langues et les terres autochtones.
Plus immediatement, les reductions de Medicare devasteraient les communautes et les etablissements de sante autochtones, car plus de 50% des Amerindiens non hispaniques dependent de l'assurance maladie publique.
Sans oublier ceux qui sont les plus touches par les effets du changement climatique, comme la suppression des financements HUD pour la relocalisation tribale en Louisiane du Sud.
L'augmentation de 10% du budget de la BIA l'annee derniere, approuvee pendant le mandat du president Biden, visait specificement a renforcer la resilience face au changement climatique. Lorsque l'ordre executif de Trump a gele tous les financements pour les programmes climatiques en janvier, les subventions liees au climat d'autres agences ont egalement ete gelees.
Le budget total de la BIA est de $1.5 milliard, repartis entre les 574 tribus reconnues au niveau federal aux Etats-Unis.
Les tribus qui ne sont pas reconnues au niveau federal, mais qui peuvent avoir un statut au niveau de l'Etat, du comte ou local, recoivent tres peu du gouvernement federal en dehors des financements pour les services sociaux.
Par exemple, le sud de la Louisiane n'a qu'une seule tribu reconnue au niveau federal : les Chitimacha (ils sont aussi la premiere tribu jamais reconnue).
Mais l'Etat de Louisiane reconnait six tribus dans la seule partie sud-est de l'Etat qui ne sont pas reconnues par la BIA.
Ces tribus preservent l'histoire, la langue et la culture franco-Amerindiennes que nous celebrons aujourd'hui. Certains de ceux qui vivent le long des bayous parlent encore exclusivement le francais.
C'est la que j'ai appris a parler francais (et c'est pourquoi mon francais sonne bien differemment de ce que vous entendrez en France, au Canada ou en Guinee).
Veuillez envisager de contacter votre representant au Congres et de lui dire de proteger les communautes tribales.
[Trouver votre representant](https://substack.com/redirect/b3c93a8e-9ffa-4c8d-a9c9-910a3b523b7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Celles qui souffrent le plus lors d'une tempete catastrophique. Celles qui ont de l'indifference d'un gouvernement qui ne se soucie pas de leur existence, et de la part de societes qui chercheraient a les effacer. La demande de reconnaissance federale est eprouvante. Je le sais, car j'ai aide trois tribus a documenter leur dans le cadre de la quete du precieux tampon d'approbation (et des ressources) de la BIA. ] Depuis plus d'une semaine, les dirigeants tribaux temoignent lors des audiences de l'appropriation des fonds concernant les potentielles (et importantes) reductions des financements deja sous pression de la BIA. Bien que moins sensationnelles que les reductions des ressources essentielles pour la modelisation des conditions meteorologiques et la reponse aux catastrophes, les coupures potentielles a la BIA menacent l'existence meme de ces nations tribales. "Les reductions ne permettent pas d'economiser de l'argent de maniere significative, mais causent de reels prejudices aux communautes tribales", a declare le president de la tribu Chippewa Cree, Harlan Baker, mardi dernier. Preoccupes que les financements et programmes de la BIA tombent sous la croisade "DEI" de Trump, les dirigeants tribaux ont exprime leur crainte face aux coupures des programmes culturels essentiels qui cherchent a maintenir et restaurer les histoires, les langues et les terres autochtones. Plus immediatement, les reductions de Medicare devasteraient les communautes et les etablissements de sante autochtones, car plus de 50% des Amerindiens non hispaniques dependent de l'assurance maladie publique. Sans oublier ceux qui sont les plus touches par les effets du changement climatique, comme la suppression des financements HUD pour la relocalisation tribale en Louisiane du Sud. L'augmentation de 10% du budget de la BIA l'annee derniere, approuvee pendant le mandat du president Biden, visait specificement a renforcer la resilience face au changement climatique. Lorsque l'ordre executif de Trump a gele tous les financements pour les programmes climatiques en janvier, les subventions liees au climat d'autres agences ont egalement ete gelees. Le budget total de la BIA est de $1.5 milliard, repartis entre les 574 tribus reconnues au niveau federal aux Etats-Unis. Les tribus qui ne sont pas reconnues au niveau federal, mais qui peuvent avoir un statut au niveau de l'Etat, du comte ou local, recoivent tres peu du gouvernement federal en dehors des financements pour les services sociaux. Par exemple, le sud de la Louisiane n'a qu'une seule tribu reconnue au niveau federal : les Chitimacha (ils sont aussi la premiere tribu jamais reconnue). Mais l'Etat de Louisiane reconnait six tribus dans la seule partie sud-est de l'Etat qui ne sont pas reconnues par la BIA. Ces tribus preservent l'histoire, la langue et la culture franco-Amerindiennes que nous celebrons aujourd'hui. Certains de ceux qui vivent le long des bayous parlent encore exclusivement le francais. C'est la que j'ai appris a parler francais (et c'est pourquoi mon francais sonne bien differemment de ce que vous entendrez en France, au Canada ou en Guinee). Veuillez envisager de contacter votre representant au Congres et de lui dire de proteger les communautes tribales. Mesoscale News with Rebekah Jones is a reader-supported publication. [] [] [] [] Six Traits to Help Your Kids Be Resilient, Resourceful, and Strong It has been said that the “hand that rocks the cradle rules the world,” and as moms, we know the truth of that statement. The things we instill in our little ones as they grow will determine their future and, beyond that, the destiny of our nation. You are raising leaders, creatives, athletes, scholars, communicators, missionaries, scientists, and innovators of all stripes. This week, we’re looking at six traits that can help your kids grow up resilient, resourceful, and strong. Dr. Paris found certain foods marketed as being healthy...

Dr. Paris explains, _"Most of my patients assume their joint issues are a normal part of the aging process. They have no idea eating the wrong foods can cause joint problems."_

_"You don't have to completely change your diet. Just eliminating**[these 5 foods from your diet](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw80M2OmzAUBeCnuewG2dd_ZOHFtIiqI2XURaeVuomMbQY3xkHgkNCnr0BRtkefdY6vGcYYulWD-gKIfXAzIAJ7BcRrZr_Mx8dxWl8WIe4vN4Z-ywG_PuiCT5ys4X9er8fj_eePeVzjd6F-_1vok-d19E_8KC39YELcUlUXTnM0tLOF11RxSiklkhS95p0wtEUiDgorIqk3B2JbZ9EfDFXOF0EjQUEY4VQJxaqSMdPazttKtab10gAne1HZTd7nPqSzn5wJcS3tZSii7nMe531YA9jYeC5jWPxoQtoelMlnwIaSijLARlYbY801DydrhtGEzwSs7rI7IRUoTrmfLjdAuYNLyj5lYPXfS0h5BpSnFIMDVg_t2_H92_3tne_hfnhW32N0s-Tnqpi0G28hxjBLBZx87h_Y9i4a_wcAAP__0fCFWA)** \- including a certain kind of vegetable - will do wonders to your life,"_ he says.

Friend,

Josh Weil here, the Dem nominee running in the critical Florida special election on April 1st.

When Ukrainian President Zelenskyy came to the White House last week, there is no reason he should have been treated as anything other than what he is: a hero.

Ukrainians have been opposing Russia’s unprovoked aggression and placing Vladimir Putin in check for years. They are fighting for their survival as a nation and a people. They are fighting for their lives.

Like so many of us, I was utterly ashamed at the childish show that Donald Trump and JD Vance put on during Zelenskyy’s visit to Washington. __America should be a beacon for freedom__ —not supporting murderous dictators.

Take it from me: as a lifelong public school teacher who has worked with kids at some of their most difficult moments, **Trump and Vance’s bullying of Ukraine’s president would be _unacceptable_ in any classroom in America**—much less in the Oval Office of the White House.

It’s pathetic and embarrassing—**but I am optimistic because right now we can actually do something about it.**

The House stands at 215 (D) to 217 (R). **_This special election could tip the balance of power in Washington, D.C. and put a stop to Trump’s strongman act._**

subject: It’s time to show them what they are doing to us

body:
Today, VoteVets is bringing half a dozen Veterans to the Capitol. Each of them have either been fired or are soon to be impacted by Elon Musk, DOGE, and the GOP as they cleave off huge swaths of the federal government to enrich themselves.
#
Peter:
Today, VoteVets is bringing half a dozen Veterans to the Capitol. Each of them have either been fired or are soon to be impacted by Elon Musk, DOGE, and the GOP as they cleave off huge swaths of the federal government to enrich themselves.
The goal is to prime everyone — Republicans in Washington, our allies, the press, and the American people — ahead of Trump’s Joint Address to Congress tonight. We are going to make the fallout of his administration’s reckless actions impossible to ignore, and we’re going to do it by telling the stories of the people who are suffering the most.
30% of the federal government are Veterans. By initial estimates, approximately 6000 Veterans have already been fired by Donald Trump. They’ve fired more Veterans than any administration in our lifetime. More will lose their jobs soon if they’re allowed to continue, and Republicans in Congress are letting it happen.
Beyond just those direct cuts and impacts, Veteran owned businesses are some of the federal government’s primary contractors. When Trump and Musk illegally cancel federal grants, loans, and programs they are also directly impacting those Veteran owned businesses.
Across the country, hundreds of thousands of Veterans are living in fear. These are men and women who devoted their lives to service in and out of uniform. They are among the best of us, and those most dedicated to this country. Donald Trump and Elon Musk are destroying everything they worked for.
Trump and Elon are ruining these Veterans’ lives, destroying the federal government's ability to serve the public, crashing the economy — and they’re proud of it. We’re a joke to them, but they’re the only ones laughing.
That’s why sharing these stories is so, so important right now.
VoteVets is going to continue gathering and sharing them. We are going to continue working publicly and behind the scenes to defend Veterans, the VA, and our National Security. We are going to work around the clock to defeat the Republicans who are enabling this.
And with your help, we’re going to succeed. We can’t lose hope — we need you involved, and we need you to stick with us. Together, we’ll make it through.
[**So, please. If you can, we’re humbly asking you to make a contribution to VoteVets to support our work.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-mar25.WvYIqH&refcode=em250304-1-f&t=1&akid=34218%2E3013755%2EAvK7s_)

name: Terry Schilling
subject: President Trump heard us. Thank you.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by American Principles Project](https://go
body:
We have not yet begun to fight. This is just the beginning.

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a5st/?__vbtrk=Mjc3ODc3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc3ODc3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend, because of YOU, because of your support, your commitment, and your unwavering dedication to fighting for the American family, I was able to go straight to Mar-a-Lago and make sure **President Trump heard us loud and clear.**
And guess what? He listened.
For the first time, a presidential campaign has made the fight against the liberal gender insanity **a pillar of its platform**.
Not an afterthought. Not a side issue. It was a pillar.
This happened because of YOU.
This happened because **you stood up and said “Enough”**... Because **you refused to let the radical left get away with its assault on _women_ , _children_ , and _families_**... And because **you gave us the firepower to take this fight to the top.**
**But listen to me, this is just step one.**
Getting men out of women’s sports is a start but it’s not the end.
The left has spent **billions** of our own tax dollars attacking our values, indoctrinating our children, and tearing apart the very foundation of this country. That stops now.
Instead of spending taxpayer dollars to fund gender clinics, puberty blockers, and woke propaganda in our schools, we should be spending that money on what actually **strengthens** **families** – _**marriage**_ , _**children**_ , _**faith**_ , and _**freedom**_.
**That’s why the American Principles Project exists.**
In politics you hear lots and lots about “special interest groups” and frankly it seems like the term has become sort of a bad word for patriotic Americans. I understand why, because I’ve been in Washington long enough to see the kind of damage they can do.
**That’s exactly why I’m leading the American Principles Project. We are the only special interest group fighting for the American family, and ONLY the American family.**
The left has the teachers’ unions, the trans activists, the woke corporations, and Big Tech...
Who do families have? They have US. **Families have the American Principles Project.**
And we’re not stopping. We’re taking this fight to every state, every campaign, every level of government.
But I need you in this fight with me.
We don’t take money from woke corporations, leftist groups, groups in bed with foreign interests, or billionaires with conflicts of interest. ---
# District 25 Sine Die
End of Session Report
---
|
---
Dear Inquirer,
---
|
---
The Virginia House of Delegates adjourned the 2025 regular legislative session on Saturday, February 22, after passing our final bills and budget amendments. This year, 1,994 bills were introduced in the House and the state Senate and 916 successfully passed both chambers, advancing to the Governor for final action.**I am proud to report that 10 of my introduced bills passed this session that address Veterans issues, investing in our children’s futures, and supporting hardworking families.** As always, thank you to everyone who contacted or visited my office to advocate for the issues that matter to you. Your advocacy truly makes a difference and I’m so grateful for everyone who shares their personal stories with me and my team.
---
In this email, you’ll find status updates on the bills I brought forward to the General Assembly, bills of note from other members, pictures from visitors to the capitol, and news and events in and around the 25th District. In this email, you’ll find status updates on the bills I brought forward to the General Assembly, bills of note from other members, pictures from visitors to the capitol, and news and events in and around the 25th District.
---
**Legislation Update**
---
|
---
Per the Code of Virginia, the Governor has 30 days to sign or veto legislation that has cleared both chambers. We will reconvene in Richmond on Wednesday, April 2nd to review the Governor’s actions. Given the narrow majorities in both the House and Senate, overriding any vetoes will be challenging. As we close out the 2025 session, I want to express my deep gratitude to the activists, advocates, and—most importantly—our constituents who helped turn pressing challenges into meaningful legislative action. Here’s an update on the legislation I introduced this session:
---
**For the bills that passed** , I look forward to working with the Governor’s office to urge him to sign them into law. **For the bills that didn’t pass this year** , I remain committed to addressing the issues they tackle—whether through community efforts, collaboration with colleagues, or reintroducing them next session. These bills represent real, tangible progress—providing relief for working families, making government more efficient and transparent, and ensuring support for our veterans. No matter the outcome, I will continue fighting to deliver results for you. Below, please find state updates on each bill I carried.
---
**Advocating for Veterans and Service Members:** **[HB1685 Military Family Early Childhood Care Fix](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/bCpALdowOBLL1506f1JkvQ~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQGxcDRbkV1FtBh3Dl76-CSfFzFJ-TYXxdbOLtaFZU0dA--xoBf0I-6ugohNiAeUKmg2Rch8ZWpJLwOR1iX7TFNg~~)** This bill will expand on my House Bill 732 from the 2024 Legislative Session which was passed with [bipartisan support and signed into law.](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/cejCLYrCCNWhVjTE8iI-qw~~/AAS2yhA~/V4tPNM964f-0QZYkZHrWSxWAkw3Q1hMZbXhwPSdKCDsZeST4Hd2Z4xchkzgZIe__kWsMCZsUk2yuso9GRR02bAY1ZPOc-pTpdMG2MTJX14GFyA9v2ZhG7LpyTzwySuMf1YgeswiflZnMfXZcWRVyCTFn8pKyTZ0ch6rMBay4a5NIvXJDe3zPjZ5RsK6-Gv5SBaLTct40G7fiN5unSv5EsZIm97uyqZ4J2i2B5Eim61QuWX2HwwvjncbGEu138G067w7jP_wyxUhJaaj5iaSVtsPrXmEdG8qL_hadhsxFxI8~) This bill helps Early Childhood Care Centers serving military families avoid duplicative and disruptive administrative requirements. _Status: I'm happy to report that this bill passed the House of Delegates and Senate with unanimous support and is now in the Governor's hands for review._ **[HB1880 Military Family IEP Help](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/nA-s06XV_lkbWECJizYnyg~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQQaXwwrLp7JQ4yfi0hc0iWb5_-1Pv_pmpJN1fdwmH9hJ5tNABE0m3WO8wNWAq5s3tiUOQ9AcroDzcNMNkTRENMg~~)** Military children often face educational disruptions, especially those needing special education services. This bill ensures timely access to Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) when families relocate, reducing unnecessary bureaucratic hurdles. _Status: I’m happy to report HB1880 passed the House and the Senate unanimously and is now on its way to the Governor's desk for final approval._ **[HB1881 Military Family School Enrollment Support](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/t4Kw2R_tWWcbp8mg1EYPdw~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQauUmy1gJlnPdrb0iWIgrbyfEMmReRYsLXmZ4MI1PU9SGb1OtA8DfK8ZgnKkfFY0MtH0URfZXJSbr59r65murEg~~)** Military families move frequently, but their children’s education shouldn’t be disrupted. HB1881 ensures smoother school transitions by encouraging public school systems to create plans allowing military children to enroll in Virginia public schools, regardless of division boundaries. _Status: This bill passed the House and the Senate unanimously and is now on its way to the Governor's desk for consideration._ **[HB1882 Military Protective Orders](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/dqT-GWjsrOTCXb2SFWVinQ~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQ-6-V0q9SGPUqNzF5-CtyAs24xYZ2WDjBx8c7-wdJLyxFwSU6JZgTFkrEJ8NJgogwaSnzhRspcu90UL3bIP58mQ~~)** This bill strengthens protections for service members and spouses who have received Military Protective Orders (MPOs) related to sexual or domestic violence. It ensures that these protections remain in effect when relocating between bases. _Status: HB1882 passed the House and the Senate unanimously, and I look forward to seeing it signed into law by the Governor._ **[HB1911 Veterans Services Protection Act](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/ZDBRPr8cQEetMmrvhaBIpA~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQWtp4t3Dn22-GoxUyQJx92H2xV3eZP14anOwnXwHUOq1RxZ7_fvWarAVpm4vh1ikpumjYt_7chCyNduXim4_RVw~~)** Our veterans deserve to receive the full benefits they have earned—free from predatory practices. The Veterans Services Protection Act would prevent unfair charges for Veterans Disability Benefits, ensuring veterans keep every dollar they’re entitled to. Organizations like the Veterans of Foreign Wars and the Virginia Department of Veteran Services already offer these services for free. _Status: While this bill did not pass this year, I remain committed to advocating for this legislation and will always stand up to protect our Veterans’ hard-earned benefits. I sincerely appreciate the Veterans of Foreign Wars for their steadfast support of this bill and their ongoing dedication to the greater good._
---
**Investing in Our Children’s Futures:** **[HB2530 Shackling Ban for Minors](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/VblbmzjQubgqYbxjWfgpwQ~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQk6HBzzV-BmWNDwjwqOWMBjum-mvyog_1Wv34i5If2JjPdP3ueqi8VhQC8uImnihVn7DgvplgLvxc6LQPa9DMEQ~~)** Everyone deserves due process and the right to a fair trial, regardless of age or circumstance. This bill seeks to ensure that minors are not subjected to restraints in the courtroom unless it is absolutely necessary to prevent harm, stop disruptive behavior, or ensure safety—when no other less restrictive alternatives are available. As our Commonwealth continues to make strides in supporting the mental and emotional well-being of our children and families, it is essential that we recognize that not every young person who enters the courtroom is a threat to themselves or others. One bad decision, especially in a moment of vulnerability, should not define a child’s future. We must approach these situations with compassion, understanding, and a commitment to helping them learn, heal, and grow. _Status: This bill has been incorporated into Delegate Cousins’ legislation,_[_House Bill 2222_](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/2lyHHE5a36pruhP38JjuRg~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQpsHrqvzCl0uODxL9VxsytLmS_BUef0OyntAckQBaVROGGhKDXnjYBsI0PR3_ubtiJ0vCXhfxksuu6egk863k5A~~) _, for which I am proud to serve as Chief Co-Patron. I appreciate Delegate Cousin’s leadership on this critical issue. Her bill was passed the House and Senate with a strong bipartisan vote._ **[HB2532 Drone Bill](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/5aOsQSdnJkFTZfCQu6V4Vg~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQe9W-js4ffuaNIhO02otiP5uGWgDv-ViM5g4fFKZlSYp00SzomPyR6akO92QPKeYsC3SGzyr4cA6anbVrEKKJnw~~)** _To strengthen public safety and emergency response, this bill streamlines the process for law enforcement to obtain search warrants for drone deployment. Drones enhance real-time situational awareness, aid in crime scene assessments, and expedite the delivery of emergency supplies._ _Status: This bill was stricken from the docket due to a lack of full consensus. I sincerely appreciate everyone who supported the legislation and those who raised concerns about potential unintended consequences. Your input will help shape a more effective and balanced proposal when we revisit this issue next year._ **[HJ436 Sound Camera Study](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/MQZAXjXzEvwRgHH7vvYEpw~~/AAS2yhA~/ooFMJuotkDmAgqk1aVfD5EZWNRCzZ7f-VBMODcMz-5rd_VKtwuCqtJgpmh0m1_ZtFr_x7MAuE2kUAoK74BT64fU2arTze0EkyGPmB5y-TMNXACmZf9N-Pqel7o_Uv_-qNmg3iCXYr53B18-kJ9eTNw~~)** Residents of the 25th District are all too familiar with the persistent nuisance of excessively loud vehicles with modified exhaust systems. What began as an annoyance has grown into a serious safety concern, particularly near our schools. This bill proposes funding a comprehensive study to identify the most effective methods for monitoring and regulating vehicle noise levels. By addressing this issue, we aim to reduce noise pollution and foster a safer, quieter environment for our neighborhoods and schools. _Status: This bill is one of many pieces of legislation designed to address the same concern. The chosen vehicle to begin studying this persistent concern is_[ _House Bill 2550_](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/FerxIwNmY37Kg3rlwgOcaA~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQl9GBG5Y1DUTcSsC9FTxevNON84bKX18Ixewsz8tu7aq4Tz2kjbT2nbHUi9IGn7VEyGOAyG5OeiZvpUARS9sxqA~~) _patroned by Delegate Rip Sullivan. The bill will allow localities in the Planning District 8 and 13, to include Prince William County, to operate noise abatement monitoring systems to test their impact on recording and enforcing exhaust system violations._ **[HB2534 DMAS; Crisis Stabilization Services](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/9sIM61YYYDNijIUnSGxBIw~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQ2HLiFKkYcoyShmdNP5lKYp6ZADO1Q5rIQAoBsXeJZNRynd9KC6Da8ipSJotpf3qPgYkDu66-kFk8ifUf81enBA~~)** This bill seeks to request a critical waiver to ensure that the soon-to-open Crisis Receiving Center in Prince William County has all the necessary resources to effectively support individuals in mental health crises. By securing this waiver, we can guarantee the center is fully equipped to provide timely and comprehensive care to those in need without further delay. _Status: I am pleased that this bill has been unanimously approved by the House of Delegates and Senate and is now on the way to the Governor's desk for final approval._ **[HB1878 SCHEV; director title change](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/Z-gdjH2mlxRfj6aWMlKxfw~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQiKtZIqpRolIm3AyEiUHtfgZUYZ-QsVgdgATvOEoh6nliHQiWPHCdajYrDUIv9zqFOI1p92QZNGcQAI9pFG8bVg~~)** This bill proposes to rename the Director of the State Council of Higher Education for Virginia (SCHEV) to Executive Director. This technical adjustment will streamline internal operations and enhance communication with key partners, while also elevating SCHEV’s role in advocating for our public colleges and universities. _Status: I'm happy to report that this bill has unanimously passed the House of Delegates and Senate and will be considered by the Governor._
---
**Supporting Working Families:** **[HB2531 Paid Family Medical Leave](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/ijG9qDQNOXQAp7S3NDNLtA~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQYUJydEF-PZ3Ne_OLmiR_1JKRmjtvqbWV-Uy8R_TWDub08OPDEzXmEu3HbPtKY7Fks5iB0qImH1Vv0lez9UZRmA~~)** In times of crisis, no family should have to choose between caring for a loved one and keeping their job. That’s why I introduced legislation to establish a paid family and medical leave insurance program, giving Virginians the security to take time off for a child’s birth, medical treatment, or caregiving responsibilities - without the fear of lost wages or job loss. _Status: The bill passed the House of Delegates with a vote of 51-47 and the Senate with a vote of 21-18. It now heads to the Governor’s desk for consideration. I look forward to working with the administration to make Paid Family and Medical Leave a reality for Virginia families._ **[HB1879 5000 Families](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/6jxRJHb7oQduIbbEfIWo8A~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQ3mVsa8n9PDMj9qPaabC7zGphqWcGs8VZ-VBnBZT8Y69YpwYP1Qep6uiWH5riY-ahJYPX-I7eMoAriNm-B-fqjw~~)** The high cost of housing continues to be a problem for Virginians, and housing instability hits families with school-age children the most. The 5,000 Families pilot program would provide rental assistance to qualifying households to help families with children in schools stay where they are, and provide data on how we can address the housing crisis. _Status: Due to budget uncertainty at the federal level, the full three-year pilot program outlined in House Bill 1879 was not included in the final conference budget report. However, a scaled-down $20 million pilot program is in progress, aiming to provide critical financial relief to Virginia families. I remain committed to collaborating with localities that have established housing trust funds to develop sustainable solutions and deliver much-needed support to those in need._ **[HB1683 Dealers; recall costs](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/zbCKl5PKQGbYKK2zqYIUnQ~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQGrV6NtGKNtArUi8vYu4stSIJP0ZesIbvDcfCgh9YcrGxHPhcInqWi0myxWPju3LeJQTsQJ2Gxot6F-Ian38GqA~~)** This bill would clarify rules for reimbursing car dealers for recall and warranty costs. It also sets a timeline for manufacturers or distributors to notify auto dealers if they are using their right of first refusal on a dealership sale or transfer. _Status: I am pleased to report that this bill passed the House of Delegates and the Senate with unanimous support and is now headed to Governor for review._ **[HB1684 Licensees engaged by buyers](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/ZKqmkieulOy1omXz9g-6ag~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQnYp3UZA2vXxV_LTBCgrKNMc1u4KwMQvFT4ELUjknby49xOXMRdj1wVC5F4DYqaTCTqTzZbAHn3bqbXgK4c_K6A~~)** House Bill 1684 requires real estate licensees working with buyers and tenants to have a written agreement prior to showing the property. Requiring a written agreement protects both the consumer and the licensee by establishing up front what everyone’s obligations are with respect to the work being done on behalf of the buyer. This bill also makes it clear that a real estate licensee representing a seller or landlord may show properties on behalf of their client to a prospective buyer or tenant without signing a representation agreement with that buyer or tenant. _Status: I am pleased to report this legislation has passed the House of Delegates and Senate with unanimous support. Next, it will be reviewed by the Governor._ **[HB2533 Accessory Dwelling Units](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/FUoUMg5-AKX80WB96S_HUw~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQelc4JIKlfQl0TAlBSI-CmCmVWK31T8uKSyrKuXAcYp96ld76-4vO7YS5OMcAs3C3uM04AaIJylkY9AchTBeymQ~~)** Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)—such as fully furnished basements or detached additions—are a valuable tool in addressing the housing affordability crisis. While they are not a standalone solution for expanding housing stock or increasing homeownership opportunities, ADUs provide quality housing options for multigenerational families and others in need of flexible living arrangements. This bill empowers localities to incorporate ADUs into their strategic plans, giving them more options to expand housing availability. _Status: I’m pleased to share that this bill has passed the House of Delegates and Senate and is now awaiting the Governor’s decision._
---
**My colleagues have also been hard at work to pass a number of impactful bills that will help Virginians across the Commonwealth. Below is just a small sample of the important work of the General Assembly this session, and I am proud to serve as a patron on several of these bills which are on their way to the Governor’s desk.** [**HB2050**](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/vj8ebsjRQoh8MtfcmyS1aQ~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQ-J6pSE_HzELJlJzgzg1Gw2Oujf_hVrgiByNLY2VHKjzsqUMyufYbDkgHY2vKBqtZYoeWTyNXotUJqWRxhTEggQ~~)**:** This bill patroned by **Delegate Bulova** creates the Occoquan Reservoir PFAS Reduction Program to reduce excessive levels of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in public drinking water derived from the Occoquan Reservoir [**HB1828**](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/zXdDX1DHNCGmrB6dLhyRuA~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQ70IXfMe4Y3kUaL7j8uqroeno23tsVJoefbLHgyjmRXKd7x501F_vi_5rjy5UdG3DsjSTrmEuuPDXmFH3g9h5PA~~)**:** This bill patroned by **Delegate Simonds** eliminates out-of-pocket costs like co-pays or deductibles for diagnostic and supplemental breast exams, including mammograms, MRIs, and ultrasounds, to make accessing critical breast cancer screenings more accessible and affordable. [**HB1844**](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/O1szLH8XEIHaLoYWppx78g~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQvQqxEN79dLFyq7Dg0UPJbJ7ko6J7yhPsqxQ-Uv1RepZUqp1wahEdrvoqSi_TWPScztnYBtQXRVu0yr2ntqnDAQ~~)**:** This bill patroned by **Delegate Maldonado** protects babies and families by setting strict limits on toxic heavy metals in baby food, requiring manufacturers to test and disclose heavy metal levels, and allowing consumers to report unsafe products, while also creating a work group to study and improve enforcement of these safety standards. [**HB2099**](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/6TLjsangRT4USlr7gnWq0A~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQDOM14a0ZXE4-n5Qg6FRrbzpJmVJeDX8rW0gyLB9fWKJoT5vGv0Q_pLA-rYD4sHF_b69Dla5_RoB5jZkNuurYBg~~)**:** This bill also patroned by **Delegate Maldonado** ensures that health insurance companies follow clearer and fairer rules when requiring prior authorization for medical services, which include faster decisions, fewer unnecessary authorization requirements, and transparency about which services need approval to make it easier to access necessary care. [**HB2371**](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/9DVofanox9c4_rtDWgYVEQ~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQ9KHiWziPItry_4kDb8hpRbhMvO09D0EUKhgbKd4u7L_5Wlg3Sjz2nTTOEReU2qRXN7e4XPCRe9Pep3FVs8He3Q~~)**:** This bill patroned by **Delegate Mundon-King** ensures health insurance plans cover birth control, including over the counter options, without charging copays or fees. If a doctor says a specific type is needed for medical reasons, the insurer must cover it without extra costs. [**HB2736**](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/p8aEg0hKHANJ5ITRrwPG1w~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQ2Y_SHv1WikgbBq0MH9WrJcN8TNbjYjqnac2ffRS1FYB9pjPr0g_N05Nr21ZIXsl6JEATCeSlf3U86YJvcKC_Jg~~)**:** This bill patroned by **Delegate Reaser** extends the Virginia Values Veterans Program to include military spouses to help military families find and maintain employment despite challenges like frequent relocations. [**HB1601**](https://go.sparkpostmail.com/f/a/Tr2-E1d5kQSSZHz_6uGf6w~~/AAS2yhA~/FxBlIOnlW2nLQKPxawbq_EAlByiGjkquQpy3ZDvpZqdaRwZ_2KlR1NGdjbFciHMQOIhdvH1wHB-nYCbqrKDkEbtLPJvLyx8zyFpVrruqfJNN0wrXeTaibBoWPNU_qMrw678cGX3wQRlpUdDqqhdZeA~~)**:** This bill patroned by **Delegate Thomas** , requires a site assessment for new high-energy-use facilities, like data centers, to evaluate their impact on nearby residential areas and schools before rezoning or permitting approval. In addition, localities have the authority to assess potential effects on natural resources and community spaces, including water supplies, agriculture, parks, historic sites, and forests.

In Prince William County, our community is powered by the dedication of federal employees, local government workers, and public school staff. Their hard work forms the backbone of our district, especially here in the 25th, where federal workers and contractors make up the majority of our families. I understand the uncertainty many of you are facing now—or may face in the future. Please know that I am committed to ensuring you have the resources and support needed to navigate these challenging times. Below, you’ll find a list of local, state, and federal resources designed to provide guidance, assistance, and reassurance. Your stability, well-being, and dignity remain a top priority. At the state level, we recognize the difficulties you are experiencing, and we stand with you. Whether you need unemployment assistance, mental health support, housing aid, or food assistance, my office is here to help. You are not alone, and we will continue working to support you through these challenging times.

David Bulova, D-Fairfax County, chair of the emergency committee._ The bipartisan committee consists of 12 members of the Virginia House of Delegates, including my colleague from the Prince William County delegation, Delegate Josh Thomas. Stay tuned for updates in the coming months on key findings and proposed solutions.

clean_body: | | District 25 Sine Die End of Session Report | Dear Inquirer, | The Virginia House of Delegates adjourned the 2025 regular legislative session on Saturday, February 22, after passing our final bills and budget amendments. This year, 1,994 bills were introduced in the House and the state Senate and 916 successfully passed both chambers, advancing to the Governor for final action.I am proud to report that 10 of my introduced bills passed this session that address Veterans issues, investing in our children’s futures, and supporting hardworking families. As always, thank you to everyone who contacted or visited my office to advocate for the issues that matter to you. Your advocacy truly makes a difference and I’m so grateful for everyone who shares their personal stories with me and my team. In this email, you’ll find status updates on the bills I brought forward to the General Assembly, bills of note from other members, pictures from visitors to the capitol, and news and events in and around the 25th District. In this email, you’ll find status updates on the bills I brought forward to the General Assembly, bills of note from other members, pictures from visitors to the capitol, and news and events in and around the 25th District. Legislation Update | Per the Code of Virginia, the Governor has 30 days to sign or veto legislation that has cleared both chambers. We will reconvene in Richmond on Wednesday, April 2nd to review the Governor’s actions. Given the narrow majorities in both the House and Senate, overriding any vetoes will be challenging. As we close out the 2025 session, I want to express my deep gratitude to the activists, advocates, and—most importantly—our constituents who helped turn pressing challenges into meaningful legislative action. Here’s an update on the legislation I introduced this session: For the bills that passed , I look forward to working with the Governor’s office to urge him to sign them into law. For the bills that didn’t pass this year , I remain committed to addressing the issues they tackle—whether through community efforts, collaboration with colleagues, or reintroducing them next session. These bills represent real, tangible progress—providing relief for working families, making government more efficient and transparent, and ensuring support for our veterans. No matter the outcome, I will continue fighting to deliver results for you. Below, please find state updates on each bill I carried. Advocating for Veterans and Service Members: ~~ This bill will expand on my House Bill 732 from the 2024 Legislative Session which was passed with ~ This bill helps Early Childhood Care Centers serving military families avoid duplicative and disruptive administrative requirements. Status: I'm happy to report that this bill passed the House of Delegates and Senate with unanimous support and is now in the Governor's hands for review. ~~ Military children often face educational disruptions, especially those needing special education services. This bill ensures timely access to Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) when families relocate, reducing unnecessary bureaucratic hurdles. Status: I’m happy to report HB1880 passed the House and the Senate unanimously and is now on its way to the Governor's desk for final approval. ~~ Military families move frequently, but their children’s education shouldn’t be disrupted. HB1881 ensures smoother school transitions by encouraging public school systems to create plans allowing military children to enroll in Virginia public schools, regardless of division boundaries. Status: This bill passed the House and the Senate unanimously and is now on its way to the Governor's desk for consideration. ~~ This bill strengthens protections for service members and spouses who have received Military Protective Orders (MPOs) related to sexual or domestic violence. It ensures that these protections remain in effect when relocating between bases. Status: HB1882 passed the House and the Senate unanimously, and I look forward to seeing it signed into law by the Governor. ~~ Our veterans deserve to receive the full benefits they have earned—free from predatory practices. The Veterans Services Protection Act would prevent unfair charges for Veterans Disability Benefits, ensuring veterans keep every dollar they’re entitled to. Organizations like the Veterans of Foreign Wars and the Virginia Department of Veteran Services already offer these services for free. Status: While this bill did not pass this year, I remain committed to advocating for this legislation and will always stand up to protect our Veterans’ hard-earned benefits. I sincerely appreciate the Veterans of Foreign Wars for their steadfast support of this bill and their ongoing dedication to the greater good. Investing in Our Children’s Futures: ~~ Everyone deserves due process and the right to a fair trial, regardless of age or circumstance. This bill seeks to ensure that minors are not subjected to restraints in the courtroom unless it is absolutely necessary to prevent harm, stop disruptive behavior, or ensure safety—when no other less restrictive alternatives are available. As our Commonwealth continues to make strides in supporting the mental and emotional well-being of our children and families, it is essential that we recognize that not every young person who enters the courtroom is a threat to themselves or others. One bad decision, especially in a moment of vulnerability, should not define a child’s future. We must approach these situations with compassion, understanding, and a commitment to helping them learn, heal, and grow. Status: This bill has been incorporated into Delegate Cousins’ legislation,~~ , for which I am proud to serve as Chief Co-Patron. I appreciate Delegate Cousin’s leadership on this critical issue. Her bill was passed the House and Senate with a strong bipartisan vote. ~~ To strengthen public safety and emergency response, this bill streamlines the process for law enforcement to obtain search warrants for drone deployment. Drones enhance real-time situational awareness, aid in crime scene assessments, and expedite the delivery of emergency supplies. Status: This bill was stricken from the docket due to a lack of full consensus. I sincerely appreciate everyone who supported the legislation and those who raised concerns about potential unintended consequences. Your input will help shape a more effective and balanced proposal when we revisit this issue next year. ~~ Residents of the 25th District are all too familiar with the persistent nuisance of excessively loud vehicles with modified exhaust systems. What began as an annoyance has grown into a serious safety concern, particularly near our schools. This bill proposes funding a comprehensive study to identify the most effective methods for monitoring and regulating vehicle noise levels. By addressing this issue, we aim to reduce noise pollution and foster a safer, quieter environment for our neighborhoods and schools. Status: This bill is one of many pieces of legislation designed to address the same concern. The chosen vehicle to begin studying this persistent concern is~~ patroned by Delegate Rip Sullivan. The bill will allow localities in the Planning District 8 and 13, to include Prince William County, to operate noise abatement monitoring systems to test their impact on recording and enforcing exhaust system violations. ~~ This bill seeks to request a critical waiver to ensure that the soon-to-open Crisis Receiving Center in Prince William County has all the necessary resources to effectively support individuals in mental health crises. By securing this waiver, we can guarantee the center is fully equipped to provide timely and comprehensive care to those in need without further delay. Status: I am pleased that this bill has been unanimously approved by the House of Delegates and Senate and is now on the way to the Governor's desk for final approval. ~~ This bill proposes to rename the Director of the State Council of Higher Education for Virginia (SCHEV) to Executive Director. This technical adjustment will streamline internal operations and enhance communication with key partners, while also elevating SCHEV’s role in advocating for our public colleges and universities. Status: I'm happy to report that this bill has unanimously passed the House of Delegates and Senate and will be considered by the Governor. Supporting Working Families: ~~ In times of crisis, no family should have to choose between caring for a loved one and keeping their job. That’s why I introduced legislation to establish a paid family and medical leave insurance program, giving Virginians the security to take time off for a child’s birth, medical treatment, or caregiving responsibilities - without the fear of lost wages or job loss. Status: The bill passed the House of Delegates with a vote of 51-47 and the Senate with a vote of 21-18. It now heads to the Governor’s desk for consideration. I look forward to working with the administration to make Paid Family and Medical Leave a reality for Virginia families. ~~ The high cost of housing continues to be a problem for Virginians, and housing instability hits families with school-age children the most. The 5,000 Families pilot program would provide rental assistance to qualifying households to help families with children in schools stay where they are, and provide data on how we can address the housing crisis. Status: Due to budget uncertainty at the federal level, the full three-year pilot program outlined in House Bill 1879 was not included in the final conference budget report. However, a scaled-down $20 million pilot program is in progress, aiming to provide critical financial relief to Virginia families. I remain committed to collaborating with localities that have established housing trust funds to develop sustainable solutions and deliver much-needed support to those in need. ~~ This bill would clarify rules for reimbursing car dealers for recall and warranty costs. It also sets a timeline for manufacturers or distributors to notify auto dealers if they are using their right of first refusal on a dealership sale or transfer. Status: I am pleased to report that this bill passed the House of Delegates and the Senate with unanimous support and is now headed to Governor for review. ~~ House Bill 1684 requires real estate licensees working with buyers and tenants to have a written agreement prior to showing the property. Requiring a written agreement protects both the consumer and the licensee by establishing up front what everyone’s obligations are with respect to the work being done on behalf of the buyer. This bill also makes it clear that a real estate licensee representing a seller or landlord may show properties on behalf of their client to a prospective buyer or tenant without signing a representation agreement with that buyer or tenant. Status: I am pleased to report this legislation has passed the House of Delegates and Senate with unanimous support. Next, it will be reviewed by the Governor. ~~ Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)—such as fully furnished basements or detached additions—are a valuable tool in addressing the housing affordability crisis. While they are not a standalone solution for expanding housing stock or increasing homeownership opportunities, ADUs provide quality housing options for multigenerational families and others in need of flexible living arrangements. This bill empowers localities to incorporate ADUs into their strategic plans, giving them more options to expand housing availability. Status: I’m pleased to share that this bill has passed the House of Delegates and Senate and is now awaiting the Governor’s decision. My colleagues have also been hard at work to pass a number of impactful bills that will help Virginians across the Commonwealth. Below is just a small sample of the important work of the General Assembly this session, and I am proud to serve as a patron on several of these bills which are on their way to the Governor’s desk. ~~: This bill patroned by Delegate Bulova creates the Occoquan Reservoir PFAS Reduction Program to reduce excessive levels of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in public drinking water derived from the Occoquan Reservoir ~~: This bill patroned by Delegate Simonds eliminates out-of-pocket costs like co-pays or deductibles for diagnostic and supplemental breast exams, including mammograms, MRIs, and ultrasounds, to make accessing critical breast cancer screenings more accessible and affordable. ~~: This bill patroned by Delegate Maldonado protects babies and families by setting strict limits on toxic heavy metals in baby food, requiring manufacturers to test and disclose heavy metal levels, and allowing consumers to report unsafe products, while also creating a work group to study and improve enforcement of these safety standards. ~~: This bill also patroned by Delegate Maldonado ensures that health insurance companies follow clearer and fairer rules when requiring prior authorization for medical services, which include faster decisions, fewer unnecessary authorization requirements, and transparency about which services need approval to make it easier to access necessary care. ~~: This bill patroned by Delegate Mundon-King ensures health insurance plans cover birth control, including over the counter options, without charging copays or fees. If a doctor says a specific type is needed for medical reasons, the insurer must cover it without extra costs. ~~: This bill patroned by Delegate Reaser extends the Virginia Values Veterans Program to include military spouses to help military families find and maintain employment despite challenges like frequent relocations. ~~: This bill patroned by Delegate Thomas , requires a site assessment for new high-energy-use facilities, like data centers, to evaluate their impact on nearby residential areas and schools before rezoning or permitting approval. In addition, localities have the authority to assess potential effects on natural resources and community spaces, including water supplies, agriculture, parks, historic sites, and forests. Meeting the Moment | In Prince William County, our community is powered by the dedication of federal employees, local government workers, and public school staff. Their hard work forms the backbone of our district, especially here in the 25th, where federal workers and contractors make up the majority of our families. I understand the uncertainty many of you are facing now—or may face in the future. Please know that I am committed to ensuring you have the resources and support needed to navigate these challenging times. Below, you’ll find a list of local, state, and federal resources designed to provide guidance, assistance, and reassurance. Your stability, well-being, and dignity remain a top priority. At the state level, we recognize the difficulties you are experiencing, and we stand with you. Whether you need unemployment assistance, mental health support, housing aid, or food assistance, my office is here to help. You are not alone, and we will continue working to support you through these challenging times. The committee is charged with identifying strategies to mitigate these effects while ensuring continued support for Virginia families and businesses. “This is about ensuring that Virginia remains prepared and resilient in the face of federal policy shifts,” Del. David Bulova, D-Fairfax County, chair of the emergency committee. The bipartisan committee consists of 12 members of the Virginia House of Delegates, including my colleague from the Prince William County delegation, Delegate Josh Thomas. Stay tuned for updates in the coming months on key findings and proposed solutions. # Happening Tomorrow: AI Model Piracy Virtual Panel
---
| The release of DeepSeek’s models earlier this year exposed a significant vulnerability for U.S. leadership in AI development: distillation and AI model piracy. Join ARI for a virtual panel at 2PM ET on Wednesday focusing on the threat of model weight theft and what the government and private sector can do to prevent adversaries from exploiting closed US AI models to build their own frontier AI.

Peter,

Starting April 1, Medicare patients will lose coverage for telehealth services.

Trump’s decision is shortsighted, foolish, and cruel. Seniors who are homebound, especially those in rural and underserved communities, rely on telehealth to manage their conditions when in-person visits aren’t feasible or necessary. What started as a safety measure during the COVID-19 pandemic has quickly become a vital service used by over 12 million Medicare patients.

Sign if you agree: Congress must protect telehealth coverage for Medicare beneficiaries. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/telehealth-coverage-act-petition?contactdata=F0Hk7ChagiE3JLDEMphxssw7OSePHsQZLJCrODA8vABjw+N2/wrniBm1gs4m9P3VrovPScBp4pBrYZDgvGTJQiY/ZlaX/VHqW+QKIIQjXZGZZTzLt5qhe6wr+Ffa+HZTLZanhOWaEZnNL8WALBQ9Ufwngb9/WChekEJwl4yz0q6ILCQSbYdZiv8axcgMafHv]

https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1892641518713766128 [https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1892641518713766128]

We can’t afford to let this coverage lapse. That’s why I’ve introduced the Telehealth Coverage Act, which will require Medicare to cover telehealth services for millions of American seniors permanently.

body:
I’m hoping I can get your help today as we take on this final stretch of the campaign.
#
Team, Mandela Barnes here.
We are officially **one month** away from Election Day in Wisconsin, when voters will head to the polls and decide our next state Supreme Court Justice.
Here’s where things stand:
The incumbents on the Wisconsin Supreme Court are ideologically split, meaning whoever wins this race will make a majority.
Judge Susan Crawford is running to continue the progress we’ve seen over the last two years — which has included creating fair legislative maps and expanding access to the ballot box.
Her opponent is a MAGA-aligned judge who wants to strip abortion rights in Wisconsin and undo the work we’ve done to unrig our democracy.
He has the backing of Elon Musk and other far-right donors, because they know that the outcome of this race will have big consequences for future elections. Elon alone has put in over a million dollars in ad spending.
**Elon thinks he can buy a state Supreme Court seat. It’s our job to remind him that democracy rules — not him.**
So I’m hoping I can get your help today as we take on this final stretch of the campaign.
Susan Crawford’s team needs resources for a big Get Out the Vote operation. They need to keep ads rolling, both online and on TV. They need to pay for canvassers and organizers to get people the info they need to cast a ballot.

Donald Trump promised on **day one** he’d bring prices down, Peter. Instead, more than a month in, everything is more expensive — from gas and groceries to rent, cars, and eggs. And what are House Republicans focused on? **Gutting Medicaid to hand trillions in tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy.** Here’s the reality of the budget they just passed:
* **$4.5 TRILLION in tax cuts** , overwhelmingly benefiting billionaires and big corporations.
* Nearly **$900 billion** in cuts from essential safety net programs — while adding **$3 trillion** to the deficit.
* No real plan to lower prices, despite their endless campaign promises.

That’s the GOP agenda in 2025: You struggle while they cash out. The American people deserve better than broken promises and billionaire tax handouts. **[At Unite the Country, we’re exposing these blatant betrayals and working to elect leaders who actually fight for working families. **_"We mustn't for a moment kid ourselves about what's happening. This is big time serious, folks," she said. "So let's be brave." - Jane Fonda_**

**GET TO KNOW BETH:
** | Beth is a single, working mother of two amazing kids. Every day, she reminds them that we live in the greatest state, in the greatest nation, in the history of the world.

Where else but the United States could a girl leave home at the age of 17, put herself through college, become the first female Mayor of her hometown, and then be asked to serve America in a presidential administration?

**Beth Van Duyne is running for Congress because she knows the people of the 24th District deserve to have a strong, principled voice in Congress.**

body:
I’d like to explain why if you’ll indulge me for a moment.

[Unsubscribe](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj1l9cgqubvidqjhkxn8r0zhbajaxqbr49psmbewz7pr7ye74run7ca45i8l6c2koadq8vmlgewf1bmzjp2xr&__stmp=ssm64a&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)

I'd like to explain why if you'll indulge me for a moment.
| |
---
| | | Hi, it's Vivek Ramaswamy.

I wanted you to hear this directly from me: _I JUST announced my candidacy for Governor of Ohio._
---
| [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
**[In a moment, I'm going to ask you to become a Founding Donor to this historic campaign – but first, I'd like to explain why if you'll indulge me for a moment.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h "In a moment, I'm going to ask you to become a Founding Donor to this historic campaign – but first, I'd like to explain why if you'll indulge me for a moment.")**

---
**WHY RUN NOW?**
---
President Trump winning re-election in November was not just another political victory – it was a seismic realignment for our country. He won every swing state. He improved his vote share of minorities and young voters. We won the House AND Senate. And heck, he even won the popular vote.

---
| [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
It was the honor of a lifetime to rally voters in battleground states, campaign on college campuses to turn out Gen-Z for Trump, and promote his America First vision at rally after rally.

---
| [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
Right now, we have a once-in-a-generation chance to make real, lasting change to the country we know and love. It's an opportunity to not just ticker around the edges of the Federal Government, but to upend it completely.

This is our moment to GUT the managerial bureaucracy, FIRE anyone connected to the weaponization of our own government against us, SLASH the size and scope of the administrative state, and usher in the GOLDEN AGE for America!

But the Deep State is already putting up the fight of its life. They're resisting change at every turn. Make no mistake – we can't afford to squander this historic opportunity. That's why President Trump needs trusted partnerships at the state level RIGHT NOW!

---
**WHY OHIO?**
---
This one's easy. I was born and raised here in the Buckeye State and graduated from St. Xavier – a Catholic high school in Cincinnati. My wife, Apporva, and I live outside Columbus, raising our two boys here. I've started multiple businesses in Ohio. I've also known JD Vance since college and campaigned all over the state for our excellent new Senator, Bernie Moreno.
---
| [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
The people here are honest, have steel in their spines, and embody the City on a Hill spirit that our country was founded upon. [As Governor, I'd be honored to represent them and the values they stand for.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h "As Governor, I'd be honored to represent them and the values they stand for.")
---
| [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
**WHY GOVERNOR?**
---
Having traveled across the country, met with hundreds of politicians, ran multiple businesses, and seen how deals really get cut in The Swamp, I have never been more certain that REAL change only gets done with buy-in at the executive level.
---
| [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
We saw up close and personal the failure of Democrat rule with Joe Biden in control of the Federal Government. We also see Democrat governors like Gavin Newsom and Kathy Hochul drive their states into ruin. On the other hand, we now see President Trump act quickly and decisively to fix our country by deporting illegal criminals, moving to cut taxes, securing our border, gutting DEI, and obliterating the Deep State. True leadership can change everything.
---
| [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
That's why I'm running for Governor in my home state of Ohio. I will partner with President Trump – just like I did on the campaign trail – at the state level to Make America Great Again. [I will be a change agent for our state and set an example of efficient, conservative governance for the rest of the country.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h "I will be a change agent for our state and set an example of efficient, conservative governance for the rest of the country.")

So there you have it. That's the "why" behind my run for Governor.

**[It would be the honor of a lifetime to have your support now that I've officially launched my campaign. I'm humbly asking you to become a Founding Donor today with a gift of any size.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h "It would be the honor of a lifetime to have your support now that I've officially launched my campaign. I'm humbly asking you to become a Founding Donor today with a gift of any size.")**

---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $4 HERE** ](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $40 HERE** ](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $400 HERE** ](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT** ](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssm64a&__onlt=h)
---
Thanks for taking a minute to read this email. I appreciate your time.

God bless you and God bless America,
Vivek Ramaswamy

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: The Wizard of Oz
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
They are trying to invoke fear.
#
This administration is much more prepared and planned this time around, in terms of the kinds of chaos that they're trying to unleash.
More than legal programs, more than policy, **they are trying to invoke _fear_**.
That is how authoritarianism works. These are the tools to get us to sacrifice and surrender our civil liberties, more than they take them.
Trump pardoned virtually all the January 6th insurrectionists, including specifically people who were arrested with threats against my life.
**I'm not going to give them my fear**. I feel more like squaring up than anything else.
When I was running in 2018, people would say, “Why should we vote for a waitress instead of this 20-year incumbent?” — understandably, right? I didn't have experience. They did. And I often talked about the story of _The Wizard of Oz_.
This was my mom's favorite movie. I know it's in the zeitgeist now because _Wicked_ is out, but genuinely: all of these big, scary things, it reminds me of the end of _The Wizard of Oz_ , where you yank back the curtain — and _it's a little guy_.
**It's a small, scared, incompetent little man**.
I think we need to remain focused. Yes, they are capable of immense amounts of damage.
It can be scary. It's not something we ignore. It's not something we check out from.
But we register it. We say, “OK.” **Then we figure out what our options are and we do the best we can, day by day**.
They're relying on us giving up. **Hell no**.
We’re going to keep standing with trans people.
We’re going to keep standing with the LGBT community.
We’re going to keep standing for the working class.
We’re going to keep fighting for a better minimum wage.
We’re going to keep fighting to guarantee healthcare.

In solidarity,
Alexandria

The first African-American woman in Wisconsin history to serve in the U.S. House of Representatives, Congresswoman Gwen Moore, took her official oath of office on January 4, 2005. Prime Minister Trudeau is now turning to King Charles III for reassurance, a move that highlights just how destabilizing Trump’s words have become.
Trump’s infamous and outlandish quotes have landed him countless headlines, but in this case it is detrimentally destroying the U.S. diplomatic relations.

Never in a million years did I think I’d get into politics.

I grew up in a working-class family, where we lived paycheck to paycheck and constantly moved wherever my parents could find work. I got my first job at 11 and haven’t stopped working since. But my work ethic paid off, and I was able to work my way up in the private sector while raising a family with the love of my life, Susan.

I first ran for the U.S. Senate in 2014 because I saw how the failed Obama-Biden agenda was harming North Carolinians in every corner of the state. I knew we needed to put power back into the hands of working-class people—so that’s what I fought to do. I defeated the sitting incumbent and helped stop the Obama agenda dead in its tracks.

Since then, I’ve focused on delivering results for our great state. From supporting our law enforcement to being tough on illegal immigration, I am committed to policies that make a real difference in our day-to-day lives.

Serving North Carolinians in the Senate is one of the greatest honors of my life.

Peter, it’s Valerie –

I’m reaching out to extend my sincerest thanks to you for helping my campaign reach our end-of-month fundraising goal, and for staying engaged during these uncertain and trying times.

Since my days serving in North Carolina’s State House to now serving in Congress, I’ve always been in the minority party. That means I’ve had to find common ground, common values, and common goals with my counterparts in order to make a change.

It’s not always easy, but I’ve learned that there’s power in bringing people together. And right now, we need unity around our shared commitment to upholding our oath to the Constitution.

Our country is at a crossroads, Peter. Our leadership on Pennsylvania Avenue is working to dismantle the very foundations of our democracy with the help of unelected billionaire Elon Musk. We need everyone – Democrat, Republican, and Independent – to stand up for our eternal values. Your support is helping us do just that.

I hope you will stay by my side as we work to secure our country’s future. Because Peter, I believe that’s something truly worth fighting for.

Thank you,

Valerie Foushee

However, I knew House Democrats would need to stand united against this disastrous budget proposal. I left the hospital and rushed straight to the airport so I could fly to DC and vote NO on this extreme agenda.

## Here's what to expect tonight...
If you are a coffee drinker you might want to have an extra cup this afternoon (try [Wired2Fish](https://substack.com/redirect/32ff14b6-f009-4a9e-a4a8-658c1f8f4ff2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and use code WECARE - its my fav).
The official White House schedule has the president arriving the Capitol at 8:40pm, beginning at 9:10pm and leaving the Capitol at 11:20pm. You read that right.
So maybe they are just screwing with the Democrat response (Michigan Senator Elissa Slotkin) or he is going to go long.
I say he is going long.
The first speech in a president's term isn't a State of the Union, its a Joint Address to Congress. The thinking is that a president will usually have only been in office a month or so and therefore can't really provide a true update of the state the union which is what is called for in the constitution.
(Fun fact, it used to be in writing and there is nothing that says it actually has to be at the Capitol although I think Trump loves the pomp and circumstance).
The difference is Trump has a bunch of stuff to report on with respect to the State of the Union. He probably has done more in the first 30 days that any modern president has whether you like him or not.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left.
