name: Ruben Gallego
subject: If Trump was telling the truth tonight, this is what he’d say
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Tonight is Trump’s joint address to the House and Senate. We already know he’s going to spin everything he’s done so far as strength, but while he plays the tough guy the people of this country are paying the price.
#

Peter, it’s Ruben Gallego.
Tonight is Trump’s joint address to the House and Senate. We already know he’s going to spin everything he’s done so far as strength, but while he plays the tough guy the people of this country are paying the price.
If he was interested in telling the truth tonight, maybe he’d start with how high egg prices are — more expensive than ever! His own Secretary of Agriculture was on Fox News yesterday telling people to raise chickens in their backyard if they couldn’t afford it. Is that supposed to be a joke?
Or, maybe he’d talk about how he’s completely on board with the House budget resolution that was passed last week. The one that directed agencies to find $880 billion in cuts to Medicaid, and another $230 billion in cuts to SNAP. Taking health care and food away from people who can’t afford it — super strong.
He might get into Social Security. You know, the program responsible for lifting millions of seniors out of poverty every year. The program we all pay into, that has paid out every benefit owed since it was created. The one Elon Musk just called a ponzi scheme. Wonder if he’ll get into that.
While he’s at it, he could mention some of the people he’s fired over the last six weeks. This is the star of “The Apprentice” after all — get up there and brag about how you’ve put thousands of Veterans out of a job, Donald. I’ll be bringing one of those Veterans with me as a guest to the address. Someone Donald Trump and Elon Musk were proud to fire after he dedicated his life to serving his country.
But, really, if Trump was going to tell the truth, he wouldn’t give the address at all. Because the truth is, Trump has outsourced the presidency to Elon Musk. He’s letting Elon do everything for him — cancel contracts, hack into millions of sensitive records, fire people. I know a lot of people who voted for Trump, but I don’t know anyone who voted for Elon Musk.
So, remember: While Trump puts on his tough guy act tonight, his tariffs are crashing the economy. Thousands of people, many of them veterans, are wondering how they’ll find another job. Millions of seniors are worried about their Social Security checks, and countless working families don’t know how long they’ll be able to put food on the table.
Elon Musk and Donald Trump are doing everything they can to make a quick buck — and make the rest of us pay for it. I’ll be doing everything I can to block the worst of it.
Times are tough, no doubt. But please, don’t check out. Stay involved however you can.
Together, we’ll make it through. But we can’t give up or lose hope. So, please, keep holding on.
Thanks,
Ruben

Please, don’t click away just yet.
As Ruben stands up for what’s right in the Senate, he’s going to need a massive team backing him up.

Mike Braun signed an executive order Monday to change the state’s parental leave policy. The order calls for women to have at least six weeks of leave after giving birth. Those who deliver via C-section will be eligible for eight weeks of leave. All full-time employees may receive 150 hours of parental leave following the birth or adoption of a child. The policy will be in place for all state employees regardless of how long they have been employed by the state. The executive order also calls for paid leave for those grieving the loss of a baby in utero at 20 weeks or later. "Strong families are the cornerstone of strong communities, and it’s so important for a family to have quality time to care for their newest member,“ Braun said in a statement. ”I believe employers should do everything they can to accommodate the needs of new parents, and today I’m setting an example by strengthening our state’s policies for paid parental leave (including adoption), childbirth recovery leave, and paid leave for those facing the tragedy of losing a baby.“ “These new paid parental leave policies will benefit women recovering from childbirth, their spouses, and the newborns whose health and development will be improved by more time with their parents in those first critical weeks.” [To Read The Full Article Click Here](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/sPY0xsJ13J69NJD_pPMn8OtRt9JPV7qNzA8EhjBBvMaR_V0nu6nW2jVfOz9vbjCvhBiEC6_cvGH6HIsg0ttMDh95vHOZ2zblOgRMj1PnGZdZS8JHdG1mk4gTpRdZdzRgacpoqM91ZJo1fIfLiWBA6B-WUI2gAqMUfUOXw6grHgMEefFok3dSK9zWm8DrwTFLCCh-qGdt9opbGLEPMGEdMfFJ0sOlN3VjjLd_0Igfxh2N11-Ro1BOIc-VGlAj-tdF6Y3M_ixkAiD-loZ5KgS3mrqfNLNPNRx6R4O_scVtwuJWoOZZb-y60evDK_Ht76BeZMkI_Tla20_98MFVe1EM7EyDx67O8dNVbPL3m1fASJT_6ENYrE9QvQ/8OcWZOcTE-PETmBAUJeJn_qr7e2_kh_f/6)

name: Tobias Read
subject: Republicans in Congress want to disenfranchise active voters
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250304em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250304em]
As Oregon’s Secretary of State, it is my duty to protect voters’ right to make their voices heard – free from unnecessary hurdles and interference.
But right now, a new bill called the SAVE Act (Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act) is making its way through Congress, threatening that principle by making voter registration significantly harder for millions of Americans. While I think it’s fair for Congress to look for ways to strengthen our elections system, it is critically important that these efforts don’t impact the ability of US citizens to register and vote in our elections.
Here’s what we know:
* The SAVE Act aims to prevent noncitizens from voting in federal elections by requiring proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote. Supporters argue it strengthens election integrity, while critics claim it creates burdensome barriers for millions of eligible voters.

* A study from the Brennan Center, a top authority on democracy and justice, found that more than 21 million U.S. citizens lack easy access to the documentation required under this bill. This means people who are legally eligible to vote could be blocked from registering.

* The latest research confirms that the majority of those affected are already engaged voters, meaning this bill would disproportionately target Americans who regularly participate in our democracy.

* Even those with citizenship documents would face new obstacles because the SAVE Act undermines secure, widely used voter registration methods like online and mail registration. Millions of voters — especially working families, seniors, and students — rely on these voter registration methods.

* These restrictions aren’t about protecting elections; they’re about making it harder for people to vote. And if passed, the SAVE Act could become a dangerous model for future efforts to roll back access to the ballot nationwide.
I’m committed to protecting and expanding access to voting — not restricting it. Oregon has been a leader in secure, accessible elections, from automatic voter registration to universal vote-by-mail. And I’m working hard to improve our oversight and accountability over our system. But we can’t take these rights for granted.
That’s why I’m asking for your support today. With voting rights under attack across the country, we must stay vigilant and resist efforts to suppress participation.
Can you donate $25 to help us defend the right to vote? Every contribution helps us protect fair and accessible elections in Oregon and across the country. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250304em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250304em]
Thank you for helping protect the fundamental right to vote.

name: Wes Moore
subject: Making strides for Marylanders to thrive
body:
This email contains material discussing the impacts of mental health. If you or a loved one is struggling, do not hesitate to reach out to the National Suicide Hotline at 988.Friend,
We need to have a conversation about mental health.
American adults who report being diagnosed with depression at some point in their life reached 29% in 2023. Suicide rates of men under 30 have risen by more than a third since 2010. Data shows that we can’t ignore this issue, especially for men and boys.
As the father of two wonderful children, I want both my son and daughter to be able to grow up with all the opportunities possible.
We need to start from the ground up. In the words of the great Marylander Frederick Douglass: “It is easier to build strong children than to repair broken men.”
This starts with investing in quality education for our youngest Marylanders, fostering an environment where students feel supported and empowered to speak up. They need to be equipped with the tools to understand how to cope when things don’t feel right.
We’re already making great strides.
In 2023, we launched a first-in-the-nation Service Year Option for high school graduates to help them find their path and purpose.
In 2024, we made sure that we rewarded our servicemembers through policies to support both veterans and military families.
And in 2025, I will be directing my entire administration to begin implementing targeted solutions to uplift our men and boys.
One of the key aspects of this is making sure that we remove the barriers that are holding many of them back — especially our returning citizens.
Mental health can take a huge toll on anyone, but with the proper care that burden can be lifted. It just requires the right support, which we are aiming to make more accessible as we continue to invest in our state.
Friend, no one needs to suffer in silence. Everyone deserves a chance to thrive, and our goal is to make sure that everyone does.
Elevate,
Wes

| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=70bdd2d4c602427a8b83c0c664cabd7c&_e=RC2TtHPSLaBFbuczu0yftZRedQd2BZH1DlGO8O1wVlDwaDpoXg2XZDUT26KcDeUXnn2FnByCODqdONwzbAq1IHnglG-APyLG9yrb8KqDQECe5pDeP7uB2llwFZ8pi87kuJhK0LjCuDgelYCbcVTC6A5RKTmdwqlc1Sda_AUXwK4ebHZIvx_pEcD5LVHWcWyXjVSCw158dcQ-rHVrHcNje5Ho8eAGMXrCs3XFeflGKEviZzfH0JNCc7ufcYTsyHONFuutCtONvHNov2HDe6_NgyfKekvkxR3Whd3ZVIRx5qjdP3ntQ10T9J24PhvKcZ0BiJ7qxCGn46qyhaKFmQNbBBGYYf9Ke_f5UncSaqlEC64%3D)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=70bdd2d4c602427a8b83c0c664cabd7c&_e=RC2TtHPSLaBFbuczu0yftZRedQd2BZH1DlGO8O1wVlDwaDpoXg2XZDUT26KcDeUXnn2FnByCODqdONwzbAq1IHnglG-APyLG9yrb8KqDQECe5pDeP7uB2llwFZ8pi87kuJhK0LjCuDgelYCbcVTC6A5RKTmdwqlc1Sda_AUXwK4ebHZIvx_pEcD5LVHWcWyXjVSCw158dcQ-rHVrHcNjew7erXBz0V3bixnDHNJ3YJbdIl_gPjsU-JTPiDx3i9Mimu8vlZAty1WNBkFHfvz34HxIGDarzluowdKCOanIT-tqR5kaXMUxy4sLGqtX9MwNejmMIAQ13zVWlUo76fGZRuFfHgp2mUVDetEQgLQzVFA%3D)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. They think you and I will be so relieved to see the border secure again and criminal illegal aliens deported, that you and I will be oblivious to this threat lying dormant under our very eyes.No way.My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.****We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.****And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the** **U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=70bdd2d4c602427a8b83c0c664cabd7c&_e=RC2TtHPSLaBFbuczu0yftZRedQd2BZH1DlGO8O1wVlDQqCu3iZBj2vfsR8fegAvjycc_ryS5Uq_s0n9MAi13A0OT66tZnmyS7dO9U4jmhpd0nZk1mGdQIse_cIJqQmkCmavpq3Cv8nRRfqjRJCk31GMLuVT7PHFlh4tenKhLdmsMvqRgI4Qb7z94N4cjeOeqBn3dRZZBJvukNiBO0mTwfnpJuopY-kNkAi2HPuYwxeo%3D)**[And AMAC Action needs your help today in this do-or-die battle to pass a Constitutional Amendment to protect your vote from being canceled out by an illegal alien or a convicted felon.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=70bdd2d4c602427a8b83c0c664cabd7c&_e=RC2TtHPSLaBFbuczu0yftZRedQd2BZH1DlGO8O1wVlDwaDpoXg2XZDUT26KcDeUXnn2FnByCODqdONwzbAq1IHnglG-APyLG9yrb8KqDQECe5pDeP7uB2llwFZ8pi87kuJhK0LjCuDgelYCbcVTC6A5RKTmdwqlc1Sda_AUXwK4ebHZIvx_pEcD5LVHWcWyXjVSCw158dcQ-rHVrHcNjewTt1HmXF6ji6c-fZvfEwfUS00EpDEaI7F3FPYYair7VztOAdClDo1ygvuolqPPePQPGS0IcIcrNCkehX9lCK2gbdILa7_mXW8u2pBWmmtRGw6PFT0gehhVQHR_dwvJDu1IRZK-nZ7pDCeqfPqZ9-oY%3D)** But I can’t do it without you. **No matter what issue you care about the most, if you and I don’t have a secure,_honest_ elections... none of it matters.**Inflation. Illegal immigration. Violent Crime. Drug use. Homelessness. The 2nd Amendment. Out of control spending. Social Security and Medicare insolvency. Right to Life. Indoctrination in our schools. Endless foreign wars. You name it. **[So please follow this link to sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=70bdd2d4c602427a8b83c0c664cabd7c&_e=RC2TtHPSLaBFbuczu0yftZRedQd2BZH1DlGO8O1wVlDwaDpoXg2XZDUT26KcDeUXnn2FnByCODqdONwzbAq1IHnglG-APyLG9yrb8KqDQECe5pDeP7uB2llwFZ8pi87kuJhK0LjCuDgelYCbcVTC6A5RKTmdwqlc1Sda_AUXwK4ebHZIvx_pEcD5LVHWcWyXjVSCw158dcQ-rHVrHcNje3HkBEbw8W2ERn_TKU_61vYQD_ByzsWrnceTseZSsbTizDqb08dTVU7TskssEpi3WHEqPIXzR4X19JLSWQuX_nyM_oiZLcH1ysiH8kjcFqJYtVa9T-wIqYqssbM2_WRxZZRbT9UdGU2R5tKmuQkcZ8A%3D)** so that AMAC Action can put your representatives in Washington and in the state legislature on notice with a simple demand: Namely, that you will not tolerate this erosion of your vote.Now, here’s the bad news:Most state constitutions grant voting rights to “every” citizen, open-ended language that liberal activists argue permits localities to authorize non-citizen and even illegal alien voting. States should amend their constitutions to instead permit “only” citizens to vote. But there’s good news, too:Seven states have _expressly_ banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio.**What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. Nearly 77% of Ohio voters approved a measure in 2022, while nearly 63% of Colorado voters approved one in 2020.** This is a solution whose time has come. You and I can do this. **[That’s why, when you’ve signed your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=70bdd2d4c602427a8b83c0c664cabd7c&_e=RC2TtHPSLaBFbuczu0yftZRedQd2BZH1DlGO8O1wVlDwaDpoXg2XZDUT26KcDeUXnn2FnByCODqdONwzbAq1IHnglG-APyLG9yrb8KqDQECe5pDeP7uB2llwFZ8pi87kuJhK0LjCuDgelYCbcVTC6A5RKTmdwqlc1Sda_AUXwK4ebHZIvx_pEcD5LVHWcWyXjVSCw158dcQ-rHVrHcNje-dACyB9Z7UsDzqG3Fgazimw2ZUOAEwqnfdKXRrxtBx0f97a7JdfLUDvcGLtHN6cxIna9QgQUSCaG-mWhq93Gf1JOIz7z9Gbmn3gFvTdEg6HO5s3DWvkNfIe3YoM7_Mh_FQFexSRxfZUEIVz0Z6R2N8%3D), I'm also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35 to give AMAC Action the resources to send out, collect, process, and tabulate millions of petitions.** The reality is, we don’t get a dime of taxpayer funding. Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America. This is important. _It means we can’t be bought._ On the other hand, the leftwing election fraud machine is funded by leftwing billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg and George Soros who are actively funneling _billions_ to dark money “non-profit” groups to “**reshape** ” our elections and our electorate.With that said, if you’re able to make a larger contribution – say $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, or even $1,000 – it would really be a life saver. Please hurry. In order to secure your vote in all future elections – and with 11.5 million illegals chomping to be included in the next census – **[your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution is vitally important.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=70bdd2d4c602427a8b83c0c664cabd7c&_e=RC2TtHPSLaBFbuczu0yftZRedQd2BZH1DlGO8O1wVlDwaDpoXg2XZDUT26KcDeUXnn2FnByCODqdONwzbAq1IHnglG-APyLG9yrb8KqDQECe5pDeP7uB2llwFZ8pi87kuJhK0LjCuDgelYCbcVTC6A5RKTmdwqlc1Sda_AUXwK4ebHZIvx_pEcD5LVHWcWyXjVSCw158dcQ-rHVrHcNjewcdjoShdQAWLfVZdo_2-zjZm0gdzl-f1buWB8gwHYzg_o8_OXzFeaSm_OlRrJg3iXu3eZpIFKtz5PlUC7oWHmC2dvMHLMUJBgjMblkRB5MOAsFibZwTMJPGTyr94rh-KLnhFTcGrlMqWU4dTEV3Wu0%3D)** Yes, this is about saving your vote from being canceled. It’s also about saving America.And it all starts with the straightforward premise that non-citizens and illegal aliens – no matter how many Kamala Harris and Joe Biden imported on their watch – should be banned from voting _and_ banned from being counted for apportioning congressional seats and electoral votes. **By Wendy Kinney**
President Trump's recent Oval Office showdown with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy was a masterclass in realpolitik--a stark contrast to the scripted diplomacy of the past. Trump dominated the exchange, offering a direct and strategic reality check that Zelenskyy seemed unprepared for. But Zelenskyy's biggest blunders didn't begin in the Oval Office--they started before he even walked through the door.
**1\. Don 't Bite the Hand That Feeds You**
Before the meeting, Zelenskyy publicly criticized Trump, dismissing his peace plan and suggesting that Trump didn't understand Ukraine's war. Then, he walked into the Oval Office demanding more aid while rejecting Trump's peace and repayment proposals--without a shred of gratitude or an apology for his remarks. Big mistake.
Trump's Response: "We have given you billions in military aid, and yet you refuse to negotiate a ceasefire or offer anything in return. That ends today."
Lesson for Zelenskyy: Trump doesn't do handouts--he expects results. Ukraine has received over $183 billion in U.S. aid, and Trump made it clear: America expects a return on investment. Whether in the form of peace, rare earth minerals, or economic concessions, Zelenskyy should have come ready to deal, not just beg. Instead, his deadly sin was pride--he refused to acknowledge past mistakes, failed to express gratitude, and offered no apology for his previous criticisms. This arrogance ensured he'd be walking into a buzzsaw.
More importantly, Zelenskyy has no incentive for peace--a negotiated settlement could mean losing his grip on power and the financial pipeline keeping his government afloat. His political survival depends on prolonging the war, which keeps him in control and the money flowing. Zelenskyy is not a wartime hero--he's a grifter who thrives on conflict.

**2\. Know Your Audience --Trump is Not Biden**
Zelenskyy's approach to Trump mirrored his dealings with Biden--emphasizing democracy, emotional appeals, and playing the victim card. That strategy failed spectacularly.
Trump's Response: "You're gambling with World War III by refusing to negotiate. Do you want peace or not? Because right now, you look like a guy who just lost his wallet at a poker table and is still trying to bluff."
Lesson for Zelenskyy: Trump is a deal-maker, not an idealist. He isn't swayed by emotional manipulation--he wants results. Instead of dramatics, Zelenskyy should have focused on hard negotiations: what Ukraine can offer, what guarantees it needs, and what mutual benefits exist.
**3\. No More Free Rides --Bring Something to the Table**
Trump's priority is ensuring that America gets paid back for its financial and military support to Ukraine. Zelenskyy, however, seemed shocked by the idea that aid isn't free.
Trump's Offer: "You have some of the richest rare earth mineral reserves in the world. The U.S. helped defend Ukraine--it's time for Ukraine to help America."
Lesson for Zelenskyy: If you're meeting with Trump, bring a business deal to the table. Trump sees international relations through the lens of mutual benefit--not handouts. If Zelenskyy had proactively proposed an economic partnership instead of reacting with surprise, the conversation could have gone differently.
**4\. America is Done Playing Ukraine 's ATM**
Zelenskyy has operated under the assumption that the U.S. will endlessly fund Ukraine's war effort with no strings attached. Trump shattered that illusion.
Trump's Ultimatum: "Make a deal, or don't expect another dime."
Lesson for Zelenskyy: Ukraine's survival depends on alliances, and Trump had the upper hand. Instead of resisting, Zelenskyy should have embraced the opportunity to forge a new, more sustainable partnership with the U.S.--one where Ukraine's resources help fund its own defense rather than relying entirely on American taxpayers.
**5\. Taking Advice from Democrats? A Costly Mistake**
Reports indicate that before meeting Trump, Zelenskyy consulted with top Democrats for advice, including a private meeting with Senator Chris Murphy just 40 minutes prior. That move immediately raised red flags.
Why It Matters: By aligning himself with Trump's political opponents, Zelenskyy signaled that he wasn't approaching the negotiation as a neutral leader seeking U.S. support--he was playing politics while still demanding aid. Even worse, Democrats and Zelenskyy have no clear plan to end this war--only to prolong it with endless U.S. funding.
Lesson for Zelenskyy: If he wants to secure future support from the U.S., he can't afford to alienate a potential Trump administration. Seeking counsel from Democrats while trying to extract funding from Trump was a strategic failure.
**6\. Zelenskyy 's Biggest Bargaining Chip--And He Blew It**
One of the biggest miscalculations of the meeting was Zelenskyy's failure to secure a minerals deal with the U.S. Trump offered economic collaboration in exchange for continued support, but Zelenskyy failed to capitalize on it.
Trump's Leverage: "We've helped defend Ukraine, now Ukraine helps America. That's how this works."
Lesson for Zelenskyy: Ukraine is rich in rare earth minerals--resources that America needs for energy independence and national security. Instead of resisting, Zelenskyy could have negotiated a favorable agreement that secured long-term U.S. investment. His failure to see the bigger picture cost him leverage and support.
**7\. From Tactical Gear to Tactical Failure**
If this meeting had been in a war zone, Zelenskyy would have fit right in. But in Trump's Oval Office? Dressing in all black like he was preparing for a covert mission didn't land well.
Trump's Unspoken Message: "This is a negotiation, not an audition for the next John Wick sequel."
Lesson for Zelenskyy: Optics matter. If you want to be taken seriously as a world leader, dressing like one is a good place to start.
**Final Takeaway**
Zelenskyy presents himself as a leader fighting for democracy, but his grip on power depends on prolonging the war. He has blood on his hands and no interest in ending the war because it is his gravy train--a means to stay in control and keep the money flowing.
Trump exposed Zelenskyy's scheme--expecting endless U.S. aid without accountability or reciprocity. But those days are over. With Trump now in charge, the blank check era is finished. If Zelenskyy refuses to negotiate peace, he won't just lose American support--he will lose everything.
Trump's offer to Ukraine was a lifeline--an opportunity for genuine peace and stability. But opportunities come with responsibility. Zelenskyy had a chance to change course--he failed. Now, he faces the consequences.

Don't miss your chance to invest in the next big disruption to smartphones. 2\. Know Your Audience --Trump is Not Biden Zelenskyy's approach to Trump mirrored his dealings with Biden--emphasizing democracy, emotional appeals, and playing the victim card. That strategy failed spectacularly. Trump's Response: "You're gambling with World War III by refusing to negotiate. Do you want peace or not? Because right now, you look like a guy who just lost his wallet at a poker table and is still trying to bluff." Lesson for Zelenskyy: Trump is a deal-maker, not an idealist. He isn't swayed by emotional manipulation--he wants results. Instead of dramatics, Zelenskyy should have focused on hard negotiations: what Ukraine can offer, what guarantees it needs, and what mutual benefits exist. 3\. No More Free Rides --Bring Something to the Table Trump's priority is ensuring that America gets paid back for its financial and military support to Ukraine. Zelenskyy, however, seemed shocked by the idea that aid isn't free. Trump's Offer: "You have some of the richest rare earth mineral reserves in the world. The U.S. helped defend Ukraine--it's time for Ukraine to help America." Lesson for Zelenskyy: If you're meeting with Trump, bring a business deal to the table. Trump sees international relations through the lens of mutual benefit--not handouts. If Zelenskyy had proactively proposed an economic partnership instead of reacting with surprise, the conversation could have gone differently. 4\. America is Done Playing Ukraine 's ATM Zelenskyy has operated under the assumption that the U.S. will endlessly fund Ukraine's war effort with no strings attached. Trump shattered that illusion. Trump's Ultimatum: "Make a deal, or don't expect another dime." Lesson for Zelenskyy: Ukraine's survival depends on alliances, and Trump had the upper hand. Instead of resisting, Zelenskyy should have embraced the opportunity to forge a new, more sustainable partnership with the U.S.--one where Ukraine's resources help fund its own defense rather than relying entirely on American taxpayers. 5\. Taking Advice from Democrats? A Costly Mistake Reports indicate that before meeting Trump, Zelenskyy consulted with top Democrats for advice, including a private meeting with Senator Chris Murphy just 40 minutes prior. That move immediately raised red flags. Why It Matters: By aligning himself with Trump's political opponents, Zelenskyy signaled that he wasn't approaching the negotiation as a neutral leader seeking U.S. support--he was playing politics while still demanding aid. Even worse, Democrats and Zelenskyy have no clear plan to end this war--only to prolong it with endless U.S. funding. Lesson for Zelenskyy: If he wants to secure future support from the U.S., he can't afford to alienate a potential Trump administration. Seeking counsel from Democrats while trying to extract funding from Trump was a strategic failure. 6\. Zelenskyy 's Biggest Bargaining Chip--And He Blew It One of the biggest miscalculations of the meeting was Zelenskyy's failure to secure a minerals deal with the U.S. Trump offered economic collaboration in exchange for continued support, but Zelenskyy failed to capitalize on it. Trump's Leverage: "We've helped defend Ukraine, now Ukraine helps America. That's how this works." Lesson for Zelenskyy: Ukraine is rich in rare earth minerals--resources that America needs for energy independence and national security. Instead of resisting, Zelenskyy could have negotiated a favorable agreement that secured long-term U.S. investment. His failure to see the bigger picture cost him leverage and support. 7\. From Tactical Gear to Tactical Failure If this meeting had been in a war zone, Zelenskyy would have fit right in. But in Trump's Oval Office? Dressing in all black like he was preparing for a covert mission didn't land well. Trump's Unspoken Message: "This is a negotiation, not an audition for the next John Wick sequel." Lesson for Zelenskyy: Optics matter. If you want to be taken seriously as a world leader, dressing like one is a good place to start. Final Takeaway Zelenskyy presents himself as a leader fighting for democracy, but his grip on power depends on prolonging the war. He has blood on his hands and no interest in ending the war because it is his gravy train--a means to stay in control and keep the money flowing. Trump exposed Zelenskyy's scheme--expecting endless U.S. aid without accountability or reciprocity. But those days are over. With Trump now in charge, the blank check era is finished. If Zelenskyy refuses to negotiate peace, he won't just lose American support--he will lose everything. Trump's offer to Ukraine was a lifeline--an opportunity for genuine peace and stability. But opportunities come with responsibility. Zelenskyy had a chance to change course--he failed. Now, he faces the consequences. body:
The AG filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to defend the Affordable Care Act’s preventative care provision.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250304&t=1&akid=1674%2E1088799%2EzaBXtI)
Affordable healthcare is consistently ranked as one of the top issues on our monthly surveys, and the Attorney General just took action on it.
**Rob joined fellow Democratic attorneys general in filing an amicus brief in support of the Affordable Care Act — specifically making sure that no-cost preventative care stays no-cost!**
Right now, the ACA requires insurance companies to provide certain preventative services like routine examinations, blood pressure checks, and cholesterol screenings at no cost to patients like you.
**But Republicans are attacking this provision in the courts, trying to make healthcare more expensive, and the Fifth Circuit Court recently sided with them.**
Rob knows that preventive care is the cornerstone of a healthy society and can be the difference between life and death. That’s why he’s urging the U.S. Supreme Court to step in and reverse the Fifth Circuit’s decision, so we can preserve this preventative care provision that millions of people rely on.

subject: This is a tax on you, plain and simple.
body:

#
Folks, At 12:01 AM today, the administration’s**25% tariff** on nearly all goods from Mexico and Canada went into effect. Immediately after, Canada retaliated with tariffs on their own, and Mexico announced it will soon enact its own countermeasures. Let me be clear: American consumers – you and your loved ones – will pay the price for this recklessness. In fact, this will cost the average household over **$1,200 more a year** for everyday essentials. **It’s a tax on you, plain and simple.** Now is the time for real leadership that puts working Americans first – not political stunts that make life more expensive for everyone. And that’s why I won’t stop fighting until these tariffs are reversed, our supply chains are stable, and American families and businesses get the relief they deserve. She’s not a career politician — she’s an organizer, a mother, and a leader who has spent her life fighting for justice because she’s lived the struggles so many families face. Born legally blind and raised in public housing in San Francisco, Lateefah became a mom at 19, juggling school, work, and the daily hustle of trying to make ends meet. Born legally blind and raised in public housing in San Francisco, Lateefah became a mom at 19, juggling school, work, and the daily hustle of trying to make ends meet. She spent years as an ordinary transit rider, rushing to catch the BART train after dropping her daughter off at school — watching firsthand as working people struggled just to get where they needed to go. name: Derek Lyons - RITE
subject: RITE WINS MAJOR VICTORY IN MARYLAND FOR ELECTION INTEGRITY AND TRANSPARENCY
body:
Ensures the public access to critical tools for holding election administrators accountable |
---
| |
---
| |
# **RITE WINS MAJOR VICTORY IN ****MARYLAND FOR ELECTION INTEGRITY AND TRANSPARENCY**

(Baltimore, MD – March 4, 2025) – Today, Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”) won a [major victory](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=09e8eda663&e=ea91f782ea) for election integrity and transparency in federal court that ensures the public access to critical tools for holding election administrators accountable to their obligation to maintain clean, up-to-date, and accurate voter rolls.

RITE [sued](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=2377cf36da&e=ea91f782ea) Maryland in January of 2024 on behalf of two citizen activists, challenging a State Board of Elections (“SBE”) regulation that stopped them from conducting investigations into whether the state was removing non-residents, the deceased, and duplicate registrations. RITE’s suit alleged Maryland’s law violated the National Voter Registration Act (“NVRA”), a federal law that requires states to provide the public access with records that reveal whether they are maintaining accurate and current voter registration records.

Plaintiffs’ investigative canvassing had revealed multiple anomalies within the state’s voter records, findings consistent with a recent legislative [audit](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=4511e1ae63&e=ea91f782ea). Rather than direct their efforts to promoting free and accurate elections, SBE responded by enacting a regulation that sought to shut down plaintiffs’ work. SBE restricted plaintiffs’ access to and use of state records, including voter history information, a key record for determining whether a state is removing non-residents from its voter lists as required by federal law. RITE sued on their behalf, and today, the U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland delivered a [resounding and complete victory](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=7ce68d2ba3&e=ea91f782ea) in RITE’s favor. The court held that the SBE had violated federal law and enjoined its unlawful effort to suppress the plaintiffs’ work. In doing so, the court fully endorsed RITE’s position that the NVRA requires that states make voter history information available to the public, the most direct ruling from any court in the country on that issue to date.

RITE’s win on behalf of plaintiffs will help ensure the public has access to important records that allow them to evaluate whether states are removing dead voters, non-residents, non-citizens, and other ineligible voters.

“RITE’s win today is a significant victory for election transparency and the rule of law. RITE warned Maryland that its regulation limiting public access to key registration records was illegal – and it is,” said RITE’s President & CEO Derek Lyons. “Today’s ruling enables citizens across the country, and in Maryland in particular, to conduct important investigative work that promotes clean voter rolls and safe, secure, and accurate elections.”
###

We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families. name: Mark Kelly
subject: Six Weeks. A rundown of the damage Trump has done before his joint address to Congress tonight.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
The sheer number of bad decisions he’s made so far have been tough to keep up with. I know it's hard to keep track, but we can't let any of this go unnoticed.
#

Team,
It’s been 6 weeks since Donald Trump returned to the White House, and tonight he’ll address the House and Senate for the first time in his second term.
The sheer number of bad decisions he’s made so far have been tough to keep up with. I know it's hard to keep track, but we can't let any of this go unnoticed.
He fired thousands of Americans without cause, many of them veterans. He let an unelected billionaire slash funding for medical research, disaster relief, public health, public safety, veterans care, and many programs you rely on. All with no analysis, no discussion, and no plan.
This week Trump is firing IRS agents and closing IRS offices to protect rich people from being audited, while you’ll be left on hold if you have questions about your taxes.
Trump is doing these things so he can get Congress to deliver a budget to his desk that will dramatically cut taxes once again for rich people — adding trillions of dollars to the debt. That budget will also kick working people, seniors, or both, off their health care.
Trump has implemented tariffs that will cost you money and plans to add more without understanding (or lying about) how tariffs work. These tariffs WILL cost you and your family money on everything from groceries to housing.
He’s launched meme crypto coins under his name and his wife’s that put tens of millions of more dollars in his pockets but decimated the finances of many of his supporters. He doesn’t care, but I do.
Trump has fired the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and the Chief of Naval Operations — both decorated, deserving public servants. He didn’t say why but I think I know — one is Black and the other is a woman.
Donald Trump will no longer acknowledge that Russia invaded Ukraine and he has walked away from an 80-year-old alliance that has kept us safe and is now aligning us with a murderous war criminal in Vladimir Putin.
Trump has installed a Fox News TV personality to run the Department of Defense and a vaccine skeptic to run our health systems. Make no mistake, you and your family are less safe because of this. Our nation is poorer and at risk because of his inability to competently govern.
He's found time to do all of this and still has done nothing to lower the price of eggs...
This is not who we are as a nation and this is not normal, but Trump is only getting started. What matters is what we do next. I will be doing everything in my power as a United States Senator to defend the working- and middle-class families who will be most impacted by the Trump Administration.
Speak out. Get involved in your community. But please, don’t sit by. No action is too small, and we need everyone doing what they can.
That’s how we’ll get through this. Together.
Thanks for reading,
Mark

Any amount helps, and it adds up fast when tons of us are chipping in together.

Friend, Wow, what a speech! President Trump is right, “America is back!” The President’s Joint Address to Congress was both a blueprint for the “Renewal of the American Dream” and a report to the American people about the remarkable successes achieved since he returned to the Oval Office.

| | Friend,

Wow, what a speech!

President Trump is right, "America is back!"

---
| |
---
| | The President’s Joint Address to Congress was both a blueprint for the "Renewal of the American Dream" and a report to the American people about the remarkable successes achieved since he returned to the Oval Office.

President Trump began his speech by highlighting the dramatic reduction in illegal border crossings—to the lowest level ever.

Then, President Trump outlined his plan to cut taxes for the middle-class and the $1.7 trillion in investment he secured to create thousands of high-paying new manufacturing jobs.

Building on the President’s work to cut billions of dollars in wasteful spending and balance the federal budget for the first time in 24 years, his work to grow the economy and fight inflation will return our nation to the prosperity of President Trump’s first term.

---
| | |
---
| | By securing our border, deporting gang members, ending the scourge of fentanyl and strengthening our military, President Trump has made both America and the rest of the world safer in the last 40 days.
---
| | |
---
| | I look forward to working with President Trump to advance the America First agenda and make our nation safe, secure, affordable, and prosperous again.

God Bless America. 🇺🇸

Sincerely,

---
| |
---
| | Nicole Malliotakis
U.S. Representative

I just have to say it: **this community on Substack is absolutely incredible.** 🤩 _Every day on the Blue Amp Substack feels like a party_ - we're sharing ideas, cracking jokes, and hyping each other up. The energy? Off the charts! If you've been following along via email or the web, now's the perfect time to jump in on the action. **We 're having so much fun, and we'd love for you to be part of it!** Consider this your personal invite to just about the coolest club around. 🥳
**WHY JOIN THE FUN ON SUBSTACK?**
**Joining us on Substack (especially in the app) isn 't just another subscription - it's joining a movement.** Here's what you get when you download the Substack app and connect with us:
* **Instant Access to Community** - The moment you're in the app, you're hanging out with me and the rest of the Blue Amp crew. Comment threads are gonna turn into lively discussions. I was just reading & replying to comments, and this will come to feel like we're all gathered in a big virtual room swapping stories. B/c, as I hope I showed during my interviews--I'm want people's stories. They explain who we are, why we do what we do. _**So don 't just read--join the conversation!**_ 💬

* **Never Miss a Beat** - With the Substack app, you'll get a buzz (_not the annoying kind, the fun kind!_) every time I post something new or start a subscriber chat. No more FOMO because you missed the email. _**You 'll always be first to know when there's a new post, a hot take, or a spontaneous live discussion.**_ 📲

* **Exclusive Extras & Easier Reading** - The Substack app is built for an awesome reading experience. It's clean, easy, and distraction-free. Some of our best stuff -- like community Q&As, bonus chats, and behind-the-scenes updates -- will be there. **By being on the Substack app with us, you get the full Blue Amp experience, exactly as I intended it.**

* * *
**🔥 HEATHER COX RICHARDSON: OUR CAN'T-MISS CONVERSATION 🔥**
Still on the fence about joining? **Let me drop a name: Heather Cox Richardson**. (Yes, _the_ Heather Cox Richardson!) If you haven't heard, I recently had a great conversation with her, and I'm still buzzing from it. Heather is a rockstar historian and author who has millions of subscribers on Substack. You read that right - millions. Why do so many people flock to her work? Because her voice is fresh and exciting. She is authentic, and brings a perspective you won't find anywhere else.
_**Heather 's daily Letters from an American newsletter has become a must-read for anyone who wants to understand what's really going on in the world.**_ She has this amazing knack for taking today's headlines and making sense of them through history - all in a way that's engaging, insightful, and yes, even fun. President Trump secured another massive $100 Billion investment, semiconductor manufacturer TSMC will be coming to Arizona, creating thousands of jobs. Eventually the United States will have 40% of the market, reducing our need to rely on Taiwan, which currently has a stranglehold on the semiconductor market. President Trump will address a joint session of Congress tonight! The president is expected to discuss tariffs, Ukraine, tax cuts, and getting the rest of his agenda through as the year progresses. The Democrats have already scripted their response as Chuck Schumer, Elizabeth Warren and Corey Booker post identical, word-for-word videos right before President Trump's speech. Political strategist and former Democratic fundraiser Lindy Li joins me on today's show. Lindy has made headlines the past few months, exposing the cult-like nature of the Democratic party and how it shunned and abandoned her for speaking out on Biden's cognitive decline. Lindy has come out as a Conservative, some circles welcoming her with open-arms, others questioning her motives. Today, we get to the bottom of who Lindy is, what message she has and where she stands today. My friend and colleague on the Morning Meeting, Dan Turrentine will then join me to give a Democratic perspective. Should Lindy have stuck it out with the party, even as they seem lost in the wilderness or does she have valid reasons to walk away?

| | Join LCV, Climate Action Campaign, Green New Deal Network, Chesapeake Climate Action Network, NextGen, and other partners and special guests for an [**_interactive 60-minute advocacy training_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/04wrM8kNw4hN/UG94Zk94WDAwTTZxUnUramtvV0lmSXFwYW5jVzB3RWVFajBUMnhmNnZ5UmlWVnF3QzJFdzZJSmk5OUlyQ0RRa0dYVFlvZ3ozbVcxYmwraGhRQ0NTTXhWV1M5cVVSeTdlTkhiNVBMOGMyaE09S0/)**this Thursday where you’ll learn how to effectively make calls to members of Congress, conduct in-person visits, and wield the power of social media.** This session will equip you with the knowledge and skills to confidently advocate for your cause, build relationships with lawmakers, and make a meaningful impact. Peter, Tonight, Donald Trump will deliver his first joint address to Congress since taking office — and we already know what to expect. We’re sure to hear more of the same lies and division instead of any real plans to make life better for Vermonters and the American people. **That is why I will not be attending Trump's joint address to Congress tonight.** Peter, I attended Donald Trump’s inauguration in January as a signal that we must stand for the peaceful transition of power, the rule of law, and our Constitution. But what we’ve seen in the last six weeks is not normal — and _we cannot treat it like business as usual._ After Donald Trump took his oath to uphold the Constitution, he got straight to work dismantling our federal government. He has attacked immigrants, our democratic allies abroad, families who rely on federal aid, the LGBTQIA+ community, federal workers, and our very Constitution. **I won't sit idly by while he lies to the American people again.** While Donald Trump uses his voice to spread lies and dangerous, anti-democratic rhetoric, I will be using mine to ensure Vermonters hear the truth. | | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=579dc60e6edc4313ad2f277508dd5812&_e=kfWhz-vX-jKIkkUPzZPHfOriAPKyMmCdFSzyOICArAXyeb9sPSn2oOPYEOAFtbKoQ0iuLKiGpuv3eLl8AdNhlKZzBapNMhjO7ldTFxkfD1CU5-fcPwv7kzVYSMCJpF1a5eG8ayA6t5gFFYVISa8YwVKd_DTl3ipki22ErpArrQtiplDNmGQGEtoIodEqFvDik-xD-LoWEXUYdQ1eV_PaIsiTqNv_vVt9IrZXK7xmzGUNuA6EojV896QOdGpBD7jus1MmbFAExdbfms6h7DOczAQZpo5CNo3bpLYkcGqj87Wv-7dgQ5-TPvXRfg26ynlr8RrxG5gZ1N8mLQPA-gSHAQ_b9a3Zz5BcLmirukrr6BWm1R-4bPn-zX2UbLmkmfpF)

| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=579dc60e6edc4313ad2f277508dd5812&_e=kfWhz-vX-jKIkkUPzZPHfOriAPKyMmCdFSzyOICArAXyeb9sPSn2oOPYEOAFtbKoQ0iuLKiGpuv3eLl8AdNhlKZzBapNMhjO7ldTFxkfD1CU5-fcPwv7kzVYSMCJpF1a5eG8ayA6t5gFFYVISa8YwVKd_DTl3ipki22ErpArrQtiplDNmGQGEtoIodEqFvDik-xD-LoWEXUYdQ1eV_PaIsiTqNv_vVt9IrZXK7xmzGW3LivEaIc4rRIMB5asLT5vhTJjxUeIjoHu6UzELZdHb4WXpA64J2_Bu-P68IPf0_7GdDjYpNotmRdPE9kCBlzY9IPduBVjPXPBsQ7qsjMqG4rX9xA9SQUJ5kO3SpV2k_gVsDYYyOgURHKtDPVIMpDZ)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>>Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---

| | | Hi, it's Vivek Ramaswamy.

I wanted you to hear this directly from me: _I JUST announced my candidacy for Governor of Ohio. _

---
** WHY RUN NOW? **
---
President Trump winning re-election in November was not just another political victory - it was a seismic realignment for our country. He won every swing state. He improved his vote share of minorities and young voters. We won the House AND Senate. And heck, he even won the popular vote.

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=39c4c91ae4614e48a8672d1a46502c60&_e=E5yFOljA7_KfZUDWoS5JFxsdnhUwivydpWwinyzMXI9zqV-An9o3PUTslZvhnN1AJDgOMnQBFeyfr50Lhm_2ZMPLKgzP9T1nE9tX_Brasd47R-oHqLmZGA1zWaxLd_F60ER05NlhXTHATI8I5Qw6zXCOl9uoEpR0NOkIww_xBgo3nqjIjvvQa2b4osKx3nj4PDDwcRctXXKV3vOplOm3F7STqQ8TTLYB-UedISUHS8G5MS47GsHzGgcYDDnzAtZbyf1XHZK1PvRiu8qMGFEmL5mhUtS3ZkPMzMT3q4a7Kb2jaGbeCw98UYJwkMg1hOjw7XgKJtq0H2Rj7IY2nDazPVHfmWr5S5yJmeQ8xiOV_9F6F3n0Zz9ZZMmQa9rANUIgs6zifF9Eo2sy5s6Ivy0nHlKzA4e_dp-K2eQCkBJauHI%3D)
---
It was the honor of a lifetime to rally voters in battleground states, campaign on college campuses to turn out Gen-Z for Trump, and promote his America First vision at rally after rally.

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=39c4c91ae4614e48a8672d1a46502c60&_e=E5yFOljA7_KfZUDWoS5JFxsdnhUwivydpWwinyzMXI9zqV-An9o3PUTslZvhnN1AJDgOMnQBFeyfr50Lhm_2ZMPLKgzP9T1nE9tX_Brasd47R-oHqLmZGA1zWaxLd_F60ER05NlhXTHATI8I5Qw6zXCOl9uoEpR0NOkIww_xBgo3nqjIjvvQa2b4osKx3nj4PDDwcRctXXKV3vOplOm3F7STqQ8TTLYB-UedISUHS8G5MS47GsHzGgcYDDnzAtZbyf1XHZK1PvRiu8qMGFEmL0tusCInPc5zNKKm0lhysLlnlRCQG1LFgJ24Iisqwb-BO0-Anb36B_RfQSR-HVpgLTLFKMffkK8_5_rVjyFwifSsQa3Psw1Bs5cC9kUyDIjsQQLvHcHNoIvzqGusbcnTbQPY59i4NAFog6maZTcnx_M%3D)
---
Right now, we have a once-in-a-generation chance to make real, lasting change to the country we know and love. It's an opportunity to not just ticker around the edges of the Federal Government, but to upend it completely.

This is our moment to GUT the managerial bureaucracy, FIRE anyone connected to the weaponization of our own government against us, SLASH the size and scope of the administrative state, and usher in the GOLDEN AGE for America!

But the Deep State is already putting up the fight of its life. They're resisting change at every turn. Make no mistake - we can't afford to squander this historic opportunity. That's why President Trump needs trusted partnerships at the state level RIGHT NOW!

---
** WHY OHIO? **
---
This one's easy. I was born and raised here in the Buckeye State and graduated from St. Xavier - a Catholic high school in Cincinnati. My wife, Apporva, and I live outside Columbus, raising our two boys here. I've started multiple businesses in Ohio. I've also known JD Vance since college and campaigned all over the state for our excellent new Senator, Bernie Moreno.
---

---
The people here are honest, have steel in their spines, and embody the City on a Hill spirit that our country was founded upon. We saw up close and personal the failure of Democrat rule with Joe Biden in control of the Federal Government. We also see Democrat governors like Gavin Newsom and Kathy Hochul drive their states into ruin. On the other hand, we now see President Trump act quickly and decisively to fix our country by deporting illegal criminals, moving to cut taxes, securing our border, gutting DEI, and obliterating the Deep State. True leadership can change everything.

# Please Support WAGOP's Election Integrity Efforts

The Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP) is serious about fighting for election integrity.

Currently, WAGOP Chairman Jim Walsh is [calling on the Trump Administration](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=fe692283c0&e=6a281f566d), via House Joint Memorial 4007, to audit how WA implements so-called motor-voter laws, shining a spotlight on the dubious practice that anyone who gets a driver's license is automatically registered to vote—even if they are here illegally.

“Nobody takes responsibility for making sure that registered voters are actual citizens and otherwise legal voters,” says Chairman Walsh. “No one does and you press the Department of Licensing, and you press the Secretary of State, and they end up pointing fingers at each other.”

At the same time, the WAGOP is challenging the Democrats’ corrupt voting practices. We’re not just reacting; we’re fighting for fair elections and election integrity in court—and we need YOUR HELP. [Support The Election Integrity Legal Fund - Washington State Republican Party.](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=a98c5fa5cd&e=6a281f566d)

Clark County is just the beginning. There, 173 ballots separate the winner from the loser. Curiously, hundreds of ballots of those who had previously moved out of district were counted—and the number far exceeds the173 difference between Democrat Adrian Cortes and Republican Brad Benton. We have gathered hundreds of affidavits that prove this. Now, Democrats and elections officials are delaying the case.

Stay tuned for the preliminary outcome of the court case in Clark County set for Thursday, March 13.
###

As we honor women this month, we must call attention to the SAVE ACT
Republicans don't want women to vote. So they’re pushing the save act or The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act. They say its purpose is to protect voters and stop illegal immigrants from voting, but really millions of Americans would lose the right to vote. The SAVE Act would require Americans to provide a birth certificate, passport, or other citizenship document to register or re-register to vote, and it would put a burden on women, especially married women.
It requires women to provide official proof of U.S. citizenship and multiple documents to prove their name change when registering to vote. And different states could impose varying and confusing requirements. Obtaining legal documents, such as certified marriage certificates or name change orders, can be costly and time-consuming. This bill could suppress the future turnout of female voters in our state and country, and we must tell our elected officials not to support it.
Join me in calling for Timmons, Graham and Scott to join the March 15 Town Hall at 2pm - Hughes Library - More information here [https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/759395/] .
Please also consider joining me at one of the many upcoming events where we are honoring our Upstate community fighting for women and girls.

State Legislative Updates
Calls to Action
Today we attended a hearing on bill H.3457—which repeals abortion ban exceptions for rape, incest, and fatal fetal anomaly—community members around the state testified to the harm of this callous bill, please contact your representatives to push back.
We also attended a hearing on H.3927 today—which bans DEI at all state offices and institutions including schools— It is almost guaranteed to pass with full Republican support, but it would still be worthwhile to let them know what you think of them calling DEI “discrimination."
*This bill is still in committee: Bill H3211: Would allow DACA recipients to obtain professional licensure in SC. Attached you will find a spreadsheet of committee members and their contact information. Please call to say that you SUPPORT this bill!
Voucher Bill Update
The SC House is debating S. 62, a school voucher bill that takes money from public schools and diverts it to private schools—without holding them to the same standards. For a deeper dive hear from HD25 Rep Wendall Jones [https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1Bc8hVu74s/] and Rep Neal Collins [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1EjXZgA9i9/] on the bipartisan effort to stop this bill. This bill hurts public school students by redirecting critical funding, leaving already underfunded schools with fewer resources. Call your legislator TODAY and tell them to VOTE NO on S. 62! Let’s fight for fully funded, high-quality public education for every child.
National Legislative Updates
Petition Push for Graham, Scott, and Timmons to hold a Town Hall
Please continue to call and ask Graham, Scott, and Timmons for virtual town halls! I have called and told them they can appear virtually or we will publicize that we had to hold a town hall without them because they refused to come. Visit our Representatives & Make Your Voice Heard
Please sign up to visit our reps on a rotating schedule. I would love to overwhelm their offices and consistently make our voices known!
Sign up to visit Lindsey Graham's office HERE. [https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0A44A9A929A5F9C34-54989547-lindsey#]

Protect Medicaid and SNAP from harmful cuts
The latest threats to federal funding will cut a third of all Medicaid funding over 10 years, greatly reducing healthcare for children, seniors, and people with disabilities.
If South Carolina were to lose federal funding for Medicaid:
* More than 1.2 million people are at risk of losing their healthcare benefits.
* It would expedite and exacerbate the closure of hospitals in rural areas, worsening the healthcare crisis
* It would straining the capacity of children’s hospitals in the state
* Risk of hunger would increase, further impacting the local economy

clean_body: Keeping Up with Kathryn Harvey alt [] Watch our FULL video HERE. [] As we honor women this month, we must call attention to the SAVE ACT Republicans don't want women to vote. So they’re pushing the save act or The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act. They say its purpose is to protect voters and stop illegal immigrants from voting, but really millions of Americans would lose the right to vote. The SAVE Act would require Americans to provide a birth certificate, passport, or other citizenship document to register or re-register to vote, and it would put a burden on women, especially married women. It requires women to provide official proof of U.S. citizenship and multiple documents to prove their name change when registering to vote. And different states could impose varying and confusing requirements. Obtaining legal documents, such as certified marriage certificates or name change orders, can be costly and time-consuming. This bill could suppress the future turnout of female voters in our state and country, and we must tell our elected officials not to support it. Join me in calling for Timmons, Graham and Scott to join the March 15 Town Hall at 2pm - Hughes Library - More information here [] . Please also consider joining me at one of the many upcoming events where we are honoring our Upstate community fighting for women and girls. "**Bexar County issues evacuation notice as brush fire spreads on Far South Side** ," via WOAI**** -- "An evacuation notice has been issued by the Bexar County Office of Emergency Management due to a rapidly spreading brush fire on the Far South Side.

According to Bexar County authorities, a brushfire is spreading rapidly in the area near Southton Road and IH-37. The fire started around 12:43 Tuesday afternoon.

Anyone in that area is urged to evacuate immediately and avoid the area until further notice. We're told some homes are being evacuated off of Old Corpus Christi Road.

According to an official Bexar County Facebook post, the evacuation order is limited to approximately 30 homes located in the southeastern part of Bexar County south of Highway 181 to the west on Donop Road, South to Southton Road and east to Streich Road.

Deputies with the Bexar County Sheriff's Office are assisting with blocking off areas due to the spreading fires. They say additional mandatory evacuation orders are in place for residents living along Duke Road in South Bexar County.

The City of San Antonio (COSA) has set up a temporary shelter for evacuees at the Mission Espada Fellowship Hall located at 10040 Espada Road.

The Atascosa County Sheriff's Office says they have responded to multiple house fires in the area of Old Pleasanton Road and Big Leaf Road due to high winds. They urge residents to avoid the area if possible and watch for first responders if travel in the area is necessary.

Texas Agriculture Commissioner **Sid Miller** has issued a statement urging Texans to take immediate precautions as "wildfire and storm risks across the state reach critical levels."

"**Bexar County issues evacuation notice as brush fire spreads on Far South Side** ," via WOAI**** -- "An evacuation notice has been issued by the Bexar County Office of Emergency Management due to a rapidly spreading brush fire on the Far South Side.

According to Bexar County authorities, a brushfire is spreading rapidly in the area near Southton Road and IH-37. The fire started around 12:43 Tuesday afternoon.

Anyone in that area is urged to evacuate immediately and avoid the area until further notice. We're told some homes are being evacuated off of Old Corpus Christi Road.

According to an official Bexar County Facebook post, the evacuation order is limited to approximately 30 homes located in the southeastern part of Bexar County south of Highway 181 to the west on Donop Road, South to Southton Road and east to Streich Road.

The City of San Antonio (COSA) has set up a temporary shelter for evacuees at the Mission Espada Fellowship Hall located at 10040 Espada Road.
